lines.af: Die Dokter doen sy oggendrondtes. Geen afspraak nodig nie, ongelukkig.
lines.en: The Doctor's on morning rounds. No appointment needed, unfortunately.

lines.af: Die tafeldoek is gedek voor enigiemand ontbyt bestel het.
lines.en: The tablecloth was laid before anyone even ordered breakfast.

lines.af: Jou haarstyl het een kyk gevat en teruggegaan bed toe.
lines.en: Your hairstyle took one look and went back to bed.

rulings.imageConcept: Bloubergstrand at first light, portrait 9:16. Table Mountain centre-right across the bay, its tablecloth cloud just beginning to pour over the summit, lit pink-gold by dawn. Foreground beach clean and empty except for wind-rippled sand patterns and white spray whipping off small breakers toward the right. Top third is open pastel sky streaked with fast-moving cloud. Crisp, real-photo light, no people, dune grass bending hard in the lower-left corner.

lines.af: Die wasgoed hang nie meer nie, dit vlieg in formasie.
lines.en: The washing isn't hanging anymore, it's flying in formation.

lines.af: Liewe buurvrou: jou laken het veilig by ons geland.
lines.en: Dear neighbour: your sheet has landed safely at our place.

lines.af: Wasgoedpennetjies verdien vandag gevaartoelae.
lines.en: Pegs are earning danger pay today.

rulings.imageConcept: West Coast fishing village at dawn, Paternoster-style whitewashed cottages with green window frames centre-right, portrait 9:16. A washing line strung between two cottages streams fully horizontal, sheets and shirts snapping like flags in golden early light. Streets are clean, packed sand, a few gulls hanging motionless mid-air against the wind. Ocean glitter far right. Top third open, a soft apricot sky with one ragged fast cloud.

lines.af: Gqeberha, ons weet. Ons wéét.
lines.en: Gqeberha, we know. We know.

lines.af: Die Vriendelike Stad het nie gevra om die Winderige Stad te wees nie, en tog.
lines.en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.

lines.af: Kaapstad stuur sterkte. En 'n ekstra pet.
lines.en: Cape Town sends solidarity. And a spare cap.

rulings.imageConcept: Gqeberha beachfront at sunrise, portrait 9:16, shot along the clean promenade toward Shark Rock Pier silhouetted centre-right. Huge golden spray explodes off the pier pilings, backlit by the rising sun over the Indian Ocean. Palms along the promenade bent in unison, fronds streaming left. One early jogger, a Black woman in bright athletic gear, leaning into the wind mid-frame right, laughing. Top third wide-open orange sky.

lines.af: Almal draf vanoggend teen 'n effense hoek.
lines.en: Everyone's jogging at a slight angle this morning.

lines.af: Gratis mikrodermabrasie op die promenade vandag.
lines.en: Free microdermabrasion on the promenade today.

lines.af: Die Suidoos het nie 'n af-knoppie nie. Ons het gesoek.
lines.en: The South-Easter has no off switch. We've looked.

rulings.imageConcept: Sea Point promenade at dawn, portrait 9:16. Atlantic swell detonating against the sea wall lower-right, sending a curtain of backlit spray across sleek glass-and-steel apartment towers glowing in first light, centre-right. Two friends in running gear, a coloured man and an Indian woman, jog at a visible lean into the wind, mid-frame right, clothes rippling. Wet, clean paving mirrors the pink sky. Top third open sky with shredded fast clouds.

lines.af: Die windpomp werk oortyd en vra nie eens dubbeltarief nie.
lines.en: The windpump's doing overtime and not even charging double.

lines.af: Selfs die skape se kuiwe lê vandag agteroor.
lines.en: Even the sheep are wearing their fringes slicked back today.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo dawn, portrait 9:16. A classic steel windpump centre-right, blades a spinning blur against a vast peach-and-lavender sky, tail vane hard over. Golden grass and low scrub streaming in one direction across the clean plain, a line of purple koppies far off. A few merino sheep lower-left, wool ruffled, facing away from the wind. Top third is enormous open sky, one long lens-shaped cloud racing through.

lines.af: Die berg het die tafel gedek. Vir tweehonderd gaste.
lines.en: The mountain has set the table. For two hundred guests.

lines.af: Die Kaapse Dokter werk deur etenstyd.
lines.en: The Cape Doctor is working straight through lunch.

lines.af: Hou jou hoed. Hou jou kind. Hou net vas.
lines.en: Hold your hat. Hold your kid. Just hold on.

rulings.imageConcept: Midday from Camps Bay, portrait 9:16. Table Mountain and the Twelve Apostles centre-right under a thick, perfect tablecloth cloud cascading down the cliffs and evaporating mid-fall. Foreground palms along the clean beachfront bent hard, fronds streaming. Turquoise sea whipped into white streaks, tiny kitesurfers' arcs of spray far right. Hard blue sky fills the open top third above the pouring cloud. Saturated, postcard-real light.

lines.af: Iewers klim 'n trampolien nou oor 'n muur.
lines.en: Somewhere out there, a trampoline is clearing a wall.

lines.af: As jou trampolien vanaand by die huis slaap, is jy die uitsondering.
lines.en: If your trampoline sleeps at home tonight, you're the exception.

lines.af: Die bure se swembad het weer 'n besoeker.
lines.en: The neighbour's pool has a visitor again.

rulings.imageConcept: Bo-Kaap at dusk, portrait 9:16. A terrace of colour-washed houses — teal, pink, lime — steps downhill centre-right, walls glowing warm against a deep violet sky. Signal Hill's grass ripples silver in the wind behind them. A potted palm on a stoep thrashes; a light cotton curtain streams out of one open upstairs window like a banner. Clean cobbled street, empty. Top third open sky with clouds tearing past the first star.

lines.af: Die see klap hande, die wind buig. Ons wil net huis toe kom.
lines.en: The sea applauds, the wind takes a bow. We just want to get home.

lines.af: Die bote bly binne. Vat die wenk.
lines.en: The boats are staying in. Take the hint.

lines.af: Sonsondergang met spesiale effekte, geen ekstra koste nie.
lines.en: Sunset with special effects, at no extra charge.

rulings.imageConcept: Kalk Bay harbour at sunset, portrait 9:16. A monster wave bursts over the harbour wall centre-right, spray flung thirty metres and lit copper by the low sun. Colourful wooden fishing boats jostle safe inside the harbour, reflections shattered by wind. Three friends — an older coloured fisherman, a young Black man, a white woman — stand well back on the clean quay lower-right, watching, jackets flattened against them. Top third open molten-orange sky.

lines.af: Ten minste maak iemand geld uit hierdie wind.
lines.en: At least somebody's making money out of this wind.

lines.af: Selfs die turbines lyk of hulle 'n blaaskans wil vat.
lines.en: Even the turbines look like they could use a breather.

lines.af: Jeffreysbaai: waar die wind oefen voor sy Kaapse skof.
lines.en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.

rulings.imageConcept: Eastern Cape wind farm near Jeffreys Bay at golden hour, portrait 9:16. A line of white turbines marches over rolling green hills toward the sea, the nearest tower centre-right, blades caught mid-blur against the amber sky. Long grass flows like water across the whole foreground, all one direction. Distant ocean glints top-right under banded sunset cloud. Top third open glowing sky. Clean, cinematic, no structures but the turbines.

rulings.comment: Make the image a black man and a black woman

lines.af: Die stoepkussings het 'n vergadering belê oor verhuising.
lines.en: The stoep cushions have called a meeting about relocating.

lines.af: Alles wat lig is, het vanaand ambisie.
lines.en: Everything lightweight has ambitions tonight.

lines.af: Maak toe, maak vas, gee oor.
lines.en: Close it, tie it down, surrender.

rulings.imageConcept: Modern white-plaster-and-timber beach house on the Garden Route at dusk, portrait 9:16, house angled centre-right above clean dunes. Dune grass streams flat in the wind, gold rim-light from the last sun. On the deck, two neighbours — a Black woman and a white man — laugh as they wrestle scatter cushions and a folded umbrella indoors, her scarf streaming. Warm interior light glows through timber slats. Top third open indigo-pink sky, clouds racing.

lines.af: Blyk die Dokter werk óók nagskof.
lines.en: Turns out the Doctor also works night shift.

lines.af: Die tafeldoek is gestryk en reg vir môre se diens.
lines.en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.

lines.af: Slaap lekker. Die wind sal die huis oppas. Hard.
lines.en: Sleep tight. The wind will watch the house. Loudly.

rulings.imageConcept: Table Bay by full moon, portrait 9:16, from Blouberg. Table Mountain centre-right, its tablecloth cloud silver-lit and spilling in slow motion, city lights strung like beads at its base. Moonlight lays a broken silver path across the wind-chopped bay toward the viewer. Foreground dune grass whips in silhouette lower-left. Top third open deep-blue sky, moon high right with a fast wisp of cloud crossing it.

lines.af: Die maste hou vanaand 'n konsert. Geen kaartjies nodig nie.
lines.en: The masts are holding a concert tonight. No tickets required.

lines.af: Gqeberha slaap nie, dit hou net vas.
lines.en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.

rulings.imageConcept: Gqeberha small-boat harbour at night, portrait 9:16. A forest of yacht masts centre-right sways against the wind, rigging taut, harbour lights scattering gold across black ruffled water. Spray mists off the breakwater far right, caught in a lamp's beam. Clean quay glistening, ropes straining neatly at their cleats. City glow low on the horizon. Top third open night sky, ragged clouds streaming past a handful of stars.

lines.af: Die wolke jaag asof hulle laat is vir iets.
lines.en: The clouds are rushing like they're late for something.

lines.af: Elke boom in die straat buig dieselfde kant toe. Groepsdruk.
lines.en: Every tree on the street is bowing the same way. Peer pressure.

lines.af: Vanaand se wind het opinies.
lines.en: Tonight's wind has opinions.

rulings.imageConcept: Coastal avenue at night, portrait 9:16. A row of tall palms centre-right bows deeply in unison, fronds streaming silver under a bright moon, trunks glossed by warm streetlamp light. Fast tattered clouds race across the moonlit sky. The clean, empty street below shines faintly; leaves and fine sea-spray hang suspended in the lamp beams like snow. Ocean a dark shimmer far right. Top third wide-open, dramatic moving sky.

lines.af: Twaalfde verdieping, en die see kom kuier steeds.
lines.en: Twelfth floor, and the sea still pops up to visit.

lines.af: Die Suidoos lees nie die regspersoon se huisreëls nie.
lines.en: The South-Easter doesn't read the body corporate rules.

lines.af: Vensters toe. Die wind maak in elk geval sy punt.
lines.en: Windows closed. The wind is making its point anyway.

rulings.imageConcept: Atlantic seaboard at night, portrait 9:16. A sleek glass-and-steel apartment tower centre-right, windows glowing in warm amber squares, its facade streaked with fine sea-spray glittering under streetlight. Below, the promenade rail and a burst of white water leaping the sea wall, backlit. Wet, spotless paving mirrors the building's light. Wind-bent aloes in a planter lower-right. Top third open night sky, cloud shreds crossing a bright moon.

lines.af: Die wind het die wolke kom wegvee sodat jy die sterre kan sien. Jammer oor al die res.
lines.en: The wind swept the clouds away so you could see the stars. Apologies about everything else.

lines.af: Plattelandse wit-geraas: een windpomp, geen af-knoppie.
lines.en: Karoo white noise: one windpump, no off switch.

lines.af: Vanaand tel jy nie skape nie, jy tel windvlae.
lines.en: Tonight you're not counting sheep, you're counting gusts.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo night, portrait 9:16. The Milky Way blazes across a crystal-clear sky filling the open top third. A steel windpump stands in silhouette centre-right, blades blurred with motion even in the dark, tail vane hard against the stars. Silver grass flows in windswept waves across the plain, a low whitewashed farmhouse wall catching faint starlight far right. Absolute clean emptiness, one meteor streak upper-left.

lines.af: Iemand het vergeet om die wasgoed in te bring. Die wasgoed het nie vergeet nie.
lines.en: Somebody forgot to bring in the washing. The washing has not forgotten.

lines.af: Môreoggend se eerste taak: 'n soekgeselskap.
lines.en: Tomorrow morning's first job: a search party.

lines.af: Die hele dorp se wasgoedpennetjies hou vanaand duim vas.
lines.en: Every peg in the village is holding thumbs tonight.

rulings.imageConcept: West Coast village night, portrait 9:16. Whitewashed fishing cottages centre-right glow blue-white under a big moon, one warm window lit. Between two cottages a forgotten washing line thrashes, a single white shirt luminous and horizontal in the wind like a ghost taking flight. Moonlit dune grass streams in the clean sandy foreground; the cold Atlantic glitters far right. Top third open star-salted sky with racing cloud shreds.

lines.af: Die lug het wakker geword met 'n houding.
lines.en: The sky woke up in a mood.

lines.af: 06:00 en die hemel het reeds 'n vergadering belê.
lines.en: 6am and the sky has already called a meeting.

lines.af: Nie eens koffie gaan dié bui regmaak nie.
lines.en: Not even coffee is fixing this mood.

rulings.imageConcept: A Highveld modern farmhouse — clean gables, corrugated steel roof, big glass panels — sits centre-right on open grassland while a green-black dawn storm cell towers behind it, its mammatus underbelly lit pink-gold by the first sun. The glass catches the sunrise colour. Top third of the 9:16 frame is pure brooding sky. Real photographic light, no people, dew on the grass, the house warm-lit and calm against the drama.

lines.af: Die weer het vroeg opgestaan om te kom oefen.
lines.en: The weather got up early to rehearse.

lines.af: Daai wolk het duidelik nie geslaap nie.
lines.en: That cloud clearly did not sleep.

rulings.imageConcept: From a grassy koppie at first light, a lone Black woman runner in bright kit pauses centre-right, hands on hips, looking out at the Joburg skyline on the horizon where silent lightning pulses inside a distant sunrise cell. The cloud glows amber-purple from within. Top third open sky, city small and low in the frame. Athletic, awed, unbothered — dawn air visible as faint mist over the veld.

lines.af: Beskuit eerste. Paniek later.
lines.en: Rusks first. Panic later.

lines.af: Gratis IMAX vanoggend, boet.
lines.en: Free IMAX this morning, boet.

lines.af: Die hond het klaar sy plek onder die bed bespreek.
lines.en: The dog has already booked his spot under the bed.

rulings.imageConcept: On the deck of a thatch safari lodge, two friends — an older Indian man and a young Zulu man in fleece jackets — sit centre-right with steaming enamel mugs, watching a brooding shelf cloud catch its first stripe of gold over the bushveld. Warm lamplight from the lodge behind them, cool blue-grey storm light ahead. Top third is heavy sculpted cloud. Companionable, unhurried, faces lit by sunrise.

lines.af: Die sonsopkoms het vanoggend op drama besluit.
lines.en: Sunrise chose drama today.

lines.af: Iewers is 'n boer nou baie in sy noppies.
lines.en: Somewhere a farmer is very chuffed right now.

rulings.imageConcept: A white Cape Dutch-gabled Free State farmstead, immaculate and proud, stands centre-right against a green-black dawn sky, its gable rim-lit by a thin blade of sunrise breaking under the storm base. Poplar windbreak bending gently, wet gravel drive shining. Top third of the portrait frame is bruised cloud with one warm crack of light. No people — the architecture is the hero, glowing against the dark.

lines.af: Selfs die water hou sy asem op.
lines.en: Even the water is holding its breath.

lines.af: Pragtig, maar ek vertrou dit vir niks.
lines.en: Gorgeous, but I trust it zero percent.

lines.af: Dis die stilte voor die groepsgesprek ontplof.
lines.en: The calm before the group chat explodes.

rulings.imageConcept: A mirror-still Highveld farm dam at dawn perfectly reflects a towering anvil cloud lit rose and slate from below. A weathered wooden jetty runs in from centre-right where a coloured man in a beanie stands with a flask, small against the doubled sky. Top third open cloud, the reflection filling the lower frame. Absolute stillness before the day breaks — beautiful, glassy, charged.

lines.af: Ry nou, wonder later.
lines.en: Drive now, wonder later.

lines.af: Die horison lyk soos 'n fliek se slottoneel.
lines.en: The horizon looks like a movie finale.

rulings.imageConcept: A red farm road cuts through young mielie fields toward the horizon, where stacked dawn storm cells glow ember-orange at their bases and charcoal above. A white bakkie, headlights on, drives away from camera centre-right, dust hanging gold in its wake. Top third is all layered sky. Cinematic depth, honest Highveld colours — rust, green, storm-blue — shot like the opening scene of a film.

lines.af: Buurtwag se nuwe agenda: die lug.
lines.en: Neighbourhood watch has a new agenda: the sky.

lines.af: Niemand gaan vandag betyds wees nie.
lines.en: Nobody is being on time today.

lines.af: Dis nie wolke nie, dis 'n lokprent.
lines.en: Those aren't clouds, that's a trailer.

rulings.imageConcept: Three neighbours — a Sotho gogo in a dressing gown, a young white man, and a Tswana woman in gym wear — stand together on the paved driveway of a sleek steel-and-glass estate home, centre-right, mugs in hand, all looking up at a boiling purple dawn cell that dwarfs the street. First light rakes across their faces. Top third of the frame is sky doing too much. Warm, communal, a little theatrical.

lines.af: Vandag se voorspelling: verhoogeffekte.
lines.en: Today's forecast: special effects.

lines.af: Iemand het die kontras heeltemal te hoog gestel.
lines.en: Someone cranked the contrast way too high.

lines.af: Die reuk van reën het klaar ge-RSVP.
lines.en: The smell of rain has already RSVP'd.

rulings.imageConcept: A sunflower field at first light, heads still closed and dew-heavy, under a bruised-purple mammatus sky that hangs like theatre rigging. An old windpomp stands centre-right, its blades silver against one seam of orange sunrise splitting the cloud base. Top third pure textured storm ceiling. Saturated but natural — the yellow-green field burning against the violet sky, the smell of coming rain almost visible.

lines.af: 16:00. Op die kop. Soos altyd.
lines.en: 4pm. On the dot. As always.

lines.af: Jy kan jou horlosie hierop stel.
lines.en: You can set your watch by this.

lines.af: Uit die kantoor gestap, reguit in 'n rolprent in.
lines.en: Walked out the office straight into a blockbuster.

rulings.imageConcept: Late-afternoon Joburg: glass-and-steel towers centre-right mirror a colossal anvil cloud climbing behind them, its top blinding white, its base slate-green over the city. Sunlight still hits the buildings gold while the sky behind goes cinematic. Shot from a rooftop garden with wild grasses in the foreground. Top third is the anvil's crown in a 9:16 portrait. Awe-scale, zero menace — the city looks lit for a premiere.

lines.af: Almal onthou skielik waar hulle karre staan.
lines.en: Everyone suddenly remembers where they parked.

lines.af: Die haelgebede het amptelik begin.
lines.en: The hail prayers have officially begun.

lines.af: Die motorafdak is nou die gewildste plek in die land.
lines.en: The carport is now the most popular spot in the country.

rulings.imageConcept: A modern Highveld farmhouse with wide carport sits mid-frame right while a father and teenage daughter, laughing, jog across the lawn toward it, the last washing snatched off the line in their arms. Behind them a cauliflower cumulonimbus boils silver and charcoal into the top third of the frame, sun still blazing on the green lawn. Motion, joy, that specific pre-hail urgency — nothing damaged, everything alive.

lines.af: Die braai gaan aan. Die vertoning ook.
lines.en: The braai continues. So does the show.

lines.af: Onthou om die TV se prop uit te trek — dis tradisie.
lines.en: Unplug the TV — it's tradition.

lines.af: Gratis vuurwerke, geen kaartjies nodig nie.
lines.en: Free fireworks, no tickets needed.

rulings.imageConcept: A thatch bushveld lodge at dusk, its boma fire glowing orange centre-right, while a vast anvil cloud on the horizon flickers with internal lightning in purple, coral and gold sunset light. Three friends of different backgrounds stand at the boma wall with drinks, backs half to camera, watching the show. Top third is the electric cloudscape. Firelight versus storm-light — two kinds of warm in one frame.

lines.af: Die hond het eerste by die bed uitgekom.
lines.en: The dog reached the bed first.

lines.af: Ons tel sekondes soos Oupa ons geleer het.
lines.en: Counting the seconds like Oupa taught us.

rulings.imageConcept: A glass-and-steel Highveld home at deep dusk, interior lamps golden, where a mother and two kids stand silhouetted at the floor-to-ceiling window centre-right, faces to the veld outside. Far across the grassland a single elegant fork of lightning drops from a violet cloud base, frozen mid-strike. Top third open storm sky. Safe-inside-looking-out — the national pastime, rendered beautiful.

rulings.comment: Middernag en die lug wys af should become Middernag en die donderweer wil nie gaan slaap nie.

lines.af: Middernag en die lug wys af.
lines.en: Midnight and the sky is showing off.

lines.af: Slaap is gekanselleer, maar kyk net daai skoot.
lines.en: Sleep is cancelled, but look at that shot.

lines.af: Donderweer op volume tien, die buurman se hond op elf.
lines.en: Thunder at volume ten, the neighbour's dog at eleven.

rulings.imageConcept: Long-exposure night shot: the Joburg skyline low and glittering centre-right beneath a monumental anvil cloud lit from inside by lightning — the whole cloud a paper lantern in purples and electric blues. Stars visible in the clear top corner of the frame. Top third dominated by the glowing cell. No people, no motion blur on the city — just scale, silence you can almost hear, and one crisp bolt caught mid-frame.

lines.af: Die plaas se beste TV-kanaal.
lines.en: The farm's best TV channel.

lines.af: Elke weerligstraal is 'n foto wat niemand betyds neem nie.
lines.en: Every flash is a photo nobody takes in time.

rulings.imageConcept: A thatch-roofed farm homestead at night, one warm window glowing centre-right, under a huge Highveld sky split in two: crystal stars overhead, and on the horizon a distant storm cell strobing soft white and violet like a lighthouse in the veld. Silhouetted acacia to the far right. Top third is star-field and cloud-glow. Intimate scale against enormous sky — the loveliest kind of insomnia.

lines.af: Die son het ingeklok voor jou wekker eers probeer het.
lines.en: The sun clocked in before your alarm even tried.

lines.af: Lug so skoon, jy kan amper tot môre toe sien.
lines.en: Air this clear should come with a warning: plans will be made.

lines.af: Weer soos dié vra mooi vir 'n verlofvorm.
lines.en: This is leave-form weather and HR knows it.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo farmstead at first light: a whitewashed Cape Dutch-style homestead with a low werf wall sits right of frame, a windpump silhouetted far off on the flat veld. Two siblings in fleece jackets sit on the stoep steps with steaming enamel mugs, first orange light raking across frost-pale scrub. Vast pastel sky fills the top third, completely open for UI; subjects centre-right, portrait 9:16, serene and golden.

lines.af: Nog 'n 'vinnige swem voor werk' — die Kaap se oudste leuen.
lines.en: 'Quick dip before work.' Nobody in history has been quick.

lines.af: Die dag het nog niks verkeerd gedoen nie. Gee hom kans.
lines.en: Zero mistakes from today so far. Sky included.

rulings.imageConcept: Dawn on the Sea Point promenade: glass-and-steel Atlantic seaboard apartment towers catch pink light behind a wide paved walkway. Three diverse friends mid-jog, laughing, positioned centre-right; the Atlantic lies calm and silver beyond the railing, Lion's Head a soft violet silhouette in the distance. Palms still, air crystal. Top third is open pale-rose sky for UI; portrait 9:16, energetic but peaceful.

lines.af: Hoëveld-oggend: koud genoeg vir 'n jas, mooi genoeg dat jy nie omgee nie.
lines.en: Highveld mornings: freezing, gorgeous, zero apologies.

lines.af: Eerste koffie buite. Die e-posse kan wag.
lines.en: Inbox: 47. Sky: flawless. Priorities: sorted.

lines.af: Als dié blou, dié vroeg? Iets broei.
lines.en: Weather this well-behaved is definitely up to something.

rulings.imageConcept: Winter-clear Highveld sunrise from a granite koppie: golden grass glowing rim-lit, two friends in beanies perched on boulders centre-right sharing coffee from a flask, breath faintly visible. Distant blue ridges layer to the horizon with a far-off city glinting. The enormous cloudless sky grades amber to cobalt, top third completely open for UI. Portrait 9:16, crisp, triumphant early-morning stillness.

lines.af: Oggende soos dié is hoekom Kapenaars nooit ophou spog nie.
lines.en: Mornings like this are why Capetonians never stop mentioning it.

lines.af: Die son vat sy tyd vanoggend, en dit wys.
lines.en: The sun took its time this morning. Worth the wait.

rulings.imageConcept: First light washing over Bo-Kaap's colour-washed terraces — teal, coral and lemon facades glowing softly, cobbled street rising to the right. An aunty in a patterned headscarf waters geraniums on her stoep, centre-right, unhurried. Table Mountain's shoulder looms hazy-blue behind the rooftops. Empty peach-to-blue sky fills the open top third for UI. Portrait 9:16, warm, proud, quietly joyful.

lines.af: Berg-oggende laat jou vergeet wat 'n deadline is.
lines.en: Signal: weak. Views: unfair. Deadlines: whose?

lines.af: Dis die soort dag waarvan die groepchat nog jare gaan hoor.
lines.en: One of those days the group chat will hear about for years.

rulings.imageConcept: Drakensberg Amphitheatre at dawn: sandstone peaks blushing pink under a flawless sky. Lower right, the timber deck of a stone-and-thatch mountain lodge where two friends wrapped in blankets cradle coffee and rusks, beanies on, grinning at the view. Mist-free valley of golden winter grass below. Subjects centre-right; top third pure open sky for UI. Portrait 9:16, awe with gees.

lines.af: Geniet dit. Die koue front het klaar sy tasse gepak.
lines.en: Enjoy it. There's a cold front out there doing warm-ups.

lines.af: Een perfekte dag uitgereik. Moet hom nie op admin mors nie.
lines.en: One perfect day issued. Non-transferable. Spend it wisely.

rulings.imageConcept: Clear winter dawn over Stellenbosch vineyards: dew silvering the bare vine rows, a white Cape Dutch gabled homestead glowing gold right of frame under old oaks. Two farm colleagues walk a row with enamel mugs, jackets on, mid-chat, centre-right. Jagged mountains stand crisp and close behind. Pale lemon-to-blue sky fills the open top third for UI. Portrait 9:16, fresh and generous.

lines.af: Vandag se son het opgedaag met attitude.
lines.en: The sun woke up and chose glorious.

lines.af: Oggendmense is dalk oor iets reg. Sê dit net vir niemand nie.
lines.en: Morning people might be onto something. Don't tell them.

rulings.imageConcept: Warm subtropical dawn on Durban's Golden Mile: gentle gold-lit surf rolling in, wet sand mirroring the sky. Centre-right, three diverse young surfers wax plain unbranded boards, silhouetted against the glow; art-deco apartment facades blush pink behind swaying palms, joggers soft-blurred on the promenade. Huge apricot sky fills the open top third for UI. Portrait 9:16, humid warmth, easy energy.

lines.af: Platteland-stilte: jy kan jou eie gedagtes hoor. Skrikwekkend.
lines.en: Small-town quiet: you can actually hear yourself think. Terrifying.

lines.af: Hier jaag niemand nie. Die son ook nie.
lines.en: Out here even the sun refuses to rush.

rulings.imageConcept: Dawn on a wide Karoo village main road: Victorian cottages with white broekie-lace verandas glow in low honeyed light, an old sky-blue bakkie parked nose-in. Centre-right, a shopkeeper rolls up a plain unbranded shutter, mid-wave to a passing neighbour on a bicycle. A church spire stands silhouetted far down the street. Enormous pastel sky, top third fully open for UI. Portrait 9:16, unhurried charm.

lines.af: Oggendson wat só lyk maak selfs Maandag draaglik.
lines.en: Even Monday looks photogenic in this light.

lines.af: Die dag begin sonder drama. Verdag, maar ons vat dit.
lines.en: Zero drama in the sky. Highly unusual. Gladly accepted.

rulings.imageConcept: Golden dawn in a proudly kept new suburb on the city's edge: contemporary flat-roofed homes with crisp white walls and warm timber screens, trimmed lawns and young trees. Three siblings in school uniforms (no visible badges) walk the pavement centre-right with backpacks, long shadows stretching behind them, one mid-laugh. A distant koppie catches the light. Clean open sky fills the top third for UI. Portrait 9:16, hopeful and bright.

lines.af: 'Net 'n uurtjie strand toe.' Vier uur later...
lines.en: 'One hour at the beach.' History's most confident lie.

lines.af: Die water is yskoud en almal maak of dit lekker is. Tradisie.
lines.en: Atlantic rule: the water is freezing and everyone lies about it.

lines.af: Weer só mooi is nie gratis nie. Iewers wag 'n suidooster.
lines.en: Weather this perfect is on loan. The southeaster keeps receipts.

rulings.imageConcept: Midday on an Atlantic seaboard beach: blinding white sand, turquoise shallows, the Twelve Apostles rising sheer to the right. Centre-right, five diverse friends wrestle umbrellas upright around a plain unbranded cooler box, towels flying, mid-laughter. Sunlight sparkles hard on the water; a paddleboarder drifts far out. Deep saturated blue sky fills the open top third for UI. Portrait 9:16, holiday-brochure perfect but candid.

lines.af: My skerm het 40 tabs oop. Die venster het een. Die venster wen.
lines.en: Forty tabs open. The window still wins.

lines.af: Produktiwiteit het gevra om verskoon te word. Die lug is dan só.
lines.en: Productivity has left the meeting. Reason: sky.

lines.af: Dié soort blou is basies 'n braai-dagvaarding.
lines.en: Skies like this are legally a braai summons.

rulings.imageConcept: Crisp Highveld midday from a Rosebank-style rooftop terrace: potted olive trees, pale timber decking, three colleagues in smart-casual around a coffee table centre-right, one gesturing at the view mid-story. The Sandton skyline stands razor-sharp against cloudless cobalt, green tree canopy rolling beneath. Hard clean shadows, zero haze. Top third pure blue and open for UI. Portrait 9:16, urban and aspirational.

lines.af: Getypoel-water: eers spyt, dan skielik tien jaar jonger.
lines.en: Tidal pool water: instant regret, then instant youth.

lines.af: Vandag se enigste vergadering is by die vlak kant.
lines.en: All meetings moved to the shallow end.

rulings.imageConcept: Bright midday at a False Bay tidal pool: a row of colour-washed Victorian bathing huts (no readable text) lines the right edge, mountains hazy-blue across the bay. Centre-right, diverse families mid-splash in the glassy pool, a kid mid-cannonball, grandparents laughing from the low wall. Sun glitter everywhere, gulls wheeling. Wide open blue sky fills the top third for UI. Portrait 9:16, pure summer-day joy.

lines.af: Hoëveld-winter: die wasgoed is droog voor die ketel kook.
lines.en: Highveld winter flex: laundry dry before the kettle's even done.

lines.af: Nul wolke. Nul verskonings. Nul kans dat ek binne bly.
lines.en: Clear sky, clear diary. One of those is a lie.

rulings.imageConcept: Late-morning Highveld garden of a modern farmhouse-style home: corrugated charcoal roof and deep shaded veranda right of frame, emerald kikuyu lawn, strelitzias along a stone wall. Two neighbours laugh over rusks and tea at a wrought-iron table centre-right, a dachshund sprawled in a sunbeam at their feet. Flawless winter-blue sky, bone dry and bright, fills the open top third for UI. Portrait 9:16, easy warmth.

lines.af: Die weer het die planne gemaak. Ons het net opgedaag.
lines.en: The weather made the plans. We just RSVP'd.

lines.af: Sonskyn soos dié los jy nie vir Maandag nie.
lines.en: You don't waste a sky like this on being sensible.

rulings.imageConcept: Sun-drenched backyard of a modern white-plaster-and-timber home: a sparkling plunge pool catches light along the lower left, lush clivias and a jacaranda's green canopy shading the boundary wall. Centre-right, four diverse friends gather around a kettle braai, thin smoke rising straight up in the windless air, one holding tongs aloft mid-argument about technique. Open saturated blue sky fills the top third for UI. Portrait 9:16, golden and unhurried.

lines.af: Karoo-blou: presies dieselfde perfekte kleur van hier tot môre.
lines.en: Karoo sky: same flawless blue for the next 400 km. Guaranteed.

lines.af: Padkos smaak beter onder 'n lug sonder einde.
lines.en: Padkos hits different under infinite sky. That's just science.

rulings.imageConcept: High noon on a Karoo backroad: a ribbon of tar runs dead straight to shimmering flat-topped koppies on the horizon. Right of frame, a farm-stall picnic table under a sprawling pepper tree, where three road-tripping friends unpack padkos from a plain unbranded cooler box, map spread out, mid-debate. Heat-clean light, endless space. A colossal cloudless sky dominates the open top half for UI. Portrait 9:16, freedom distilled.

lines.af: Die berg het vandag sy tafeldoek by die huis gelos. Volle mondering.
lines.en: The mountain skipped the tablecloth today. Full outfit reveal.

lines.af: Só 'n dag koop jy nie. Jy kry hom net.
lines.en: Days like this aren't earned. They're issued.

rulings.imageConcept: Midday on a sweeping botanical-garden lawn beneath Table Mountain's eastern buttresses: sheer grey rock against pure blue, ancient camphor trees in the left distance, king proteas blooming along a path. Centre-right, a diverse extended family of six picnics on spread blankets with wicker baskets, a toddler chasing a guinea fowl, everyone golden-lit. Saturated green meets stone and sky; top third open for UI. Portrait 9:16, abundant and proud.

lines.af: Ons voorspelling: mooi. Ons het dit self twee keer gecheck.
lines.en: Forecast: gorgeous. We double-checked. Still gorgeous.

lines.af: 'Waarskynlik sonnig' was nog nooit só maklik om te sê nie.
lines.en: 'Probably sunny' has never felt less like guessing.

rulings.imageConcept: Golden midday in a Free State sandstone village square: honey-coloured cottages with green corrugated roofs, ochre cliffs rising warm behind them under crisp highland light. Centre-right, three friends browse an open-air pottery stall with plain unglazed ware, one holding up a bowl to the light, a sleepy border collie at their feet. Thin dry air, hard shadows, cloudless sky filling the open top third for UI. Portrait 9:16, wholesome and bright.

lines.af: Kanselleer alles. Dis DIÉ dag.
lines.en: Cancel everything. This is THE day winter was hiding.

lines.af: Strand in die winter: dieselfde see, nul geveg oor parkering.
lines.en: Off-season beach: same ocean, zero fight for parking.

rulings.imageConcept: A vast empty Garden Route beach at midday: long lines of white foam rolling in over firm gold sand, forested dunes and a hazy headland anchoring the right edge. Centre-right, two friends walk the waterline with a loping golden retriever, jeans rolled up, shoes in hand, tiny against the scale of it. Winter-clear light, sea sparkling to the horizon. Endless clean sky fills the open top third for UI. Portrait 9:16, expansive calm.

rulings.comment: Die son sak asof hy weet ons kyk.

lines.af: 'Een sundowner,' sê die mense wat die sterre gaan sien uitkom.
lines.en: 'Just one sundowner' — famous last words, every single time.

lines.af: Die son gaan af soos hy weet ons kyk.
lines.en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.

rulings.imageConcept: Golden hour on a grassy Signal Hill slope: the city bowl glows amber below and the Atlantic burns molten toward the sinking sun. Centre-right, five diverse friends sprawl on blankets with flasks and plain unbranded snack tins, one pointing at a distant paraglider, all backlit in warm rim light. Lion's Head rises dark beyond. The top third is wide-open glowing sky for UI. Portrait 9:16, communal magic-hour glow.

lines.af: Dié lug is die rede hoekom niemand vanaand vroeg huis toe gaan nie.
lines.en: Nobody's leaving early under a sky like this.

lines.af: As die weer só gedra, gedra ons ook. Min of meer.
lines.en: When the weather behaves this well, so do we. Roughly.

lines.af: Check jy die weer, of check jy of Saterdag se braai aan is? Presies.
lines.en: Be honest — you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.

rulings.imageConcept: Dusk in a Highveld backyard: a modern farmhouse with a wraparound stoep glows warm-lit right of frame. Two neighbours coax new coals in a built stone braai centre-right, sparks lifting into still air, while kids play barefoot soccer on the darkening lawn. The winter sky grades peach through violet to deep blue, first planet visible. Top third open sky for UI. Portrait 9:16, the evening settling in beautifully.

lines.af: Die dag was so mooi, selfs die verkeer het saamgespeel.
lines.en: A day so good even rush hour felt optional.

lines.af: Goue uur op die Hoëveld: gratis, en steeds onbetaalbaar.
lines.en: Highveld golden hour: costs nothing, upstages everything.

rulings.imageConcept: Johannesburg golden hour from a Maboneng-style rooftop: the skyline glows bronze through clean dry air, Hillbrow Tower a distant silhouette. Centre-right, four colleagues clink glasses from plain unbranded bottles around a reclaimed-timber table, ties loosened, laughing at the day. Unlit festoon bulbs string overhead against the light. Dust-gold light everywhere; open apricot sky fills the top third for UI. Portrait 9:16, city pride at full volume.

lines.af: Goue uur: elke dag gratis, en ons is elke dag weer verbaas.
lines.en: Golden hour runs daily. Attendance still somehow optional.

lines.af: Die aand het opgedaag met sy Sondagklere aan.
lines.en: The evening showed up in its Sunday best.

rulings.imageConcept: Last light over Stellenbosch vineyard rows: a white Cape Dutch homestead gable glows amber right of frame under towering oaks. Three friends stroll a gravel farm lane centre-right with a wicker picnic basket, jerseys over shoulders, unhurried. The mountains turn plum-purple, swallows stitch the air, vine rows converge into gold. Sky grades peach to indigo, top third open for UI. Portrait 9:16, soft and abundant.

lines.af: Stoepsit-weer. Die TV kan maar wag.
lines.en: Verandah weather. The couch will understand.

lines.af: Die beste sitplek in die huis is buite.
lines.en: Best seat in the house isn't in the house.

rulings.imageConcept: Dusk on a Victorian veranda with white broekie-lace ironwork: warm lamplight spills across polished red-cement floors. Three neighbours settle into wicker chairs centre-right with tea and a plate of biscuits, one mid-story with hands raised. The garden falls into soft silhouette beyond the railing, swifts wheeling against a rose-gold-to-violet sky. Top third open glowing sky for UI. Portrait 9:16, deep stoep-sitting comfort.

lines.af: Laaste swem van die dag voel altyd soos 'n geheim.
lines.en: Last swim of the day always feels like a secret.

lines.af: Weer só rustig maak 'n mens agterdogtig én dankbaar.
lines.en: Suspiciously calm out there. We'll allow it.

rulings.imageConcept: Dusk at a False Bay tidal pool: glassy water mirroring a tangerine-and-rose sky, the low stone wall running toward mountains gone charcoal across the bay. Centre-right, two friends towel off on the wall, wetsuits half-peeled, laughing through chattering teeth, hair dripping. The sea beyond is calm satin. Everything glows in the last warm light; top third open radiant sky for UI. Portrait 9:16, serene and earned.

lines.af: Die reëls is eenvoudig: laaste boulbeurt wanneer die straatligte aankom.
lines.en: House rules: last over when the streetlights win.

lines.af: Klein dorpie, groot lug, geen haas nie.
lines.en: Small town, giant sky, zero rush.

rulings.imageConcept: Violet dusk over a wide Karoo village street: Victorian cottages with broekie-lace verandas on either side, a windpump silhouetted beyond the rooftops, the first star out. Centre-right, kids play street cricket with a plastic bat and a wheelie-bin wicket, mid-appeal, while grandparents watch grinning from a garden gate. Dusty gold fades to purple overhead; top third open sky for UI. Portrait 9:16, timeless small-town gees.

rulings.comment: Die Kaap wys presies hoekom almal so aangaan oor hom.

lines.af: Die Kaap wys af en toe presies hoekom almal so aangaan oor hom.
lines.en: Every so often Cape Town explains itself. No notes.

lines.af: Aandete smaak beter as die pad soontoe só lyk.
lines.en: Dinner tastes better when the walk there looks like this.

rulings.imageConcept: Pink dusk on Bo-Kaap: colour-washed facades deepening to jewel tones, cobbles glowing underfoot, Signal Hill a dark velvet mass behind the rooftops with a minaret silhouette in the distance. Centre-right, three friends walk uphill carrying plain brown bakery bags, one mid-laugh looking back over a shoulder. Windows begin to warm with light. Sky blushes rose into deep blue, top third open for UI. Portrait 9:16, homeward-bound glow.

lines.af: Iemand het die sterre se volume opgedraai.
lines.en: Someone turned the stars up to full volume.

lines.af: Die kole is amper dood. Die stories kom nou eers by.
lines.en: Coals fading, stories only warming up.

lines.af: Stadsmense betaal groot geld hiervoor. Hier's dit sommer verniet.
lines.en: City folk pay good money for this ceiling.

rulings.imageConcept: Moonless Karoo night: the Milky Way arches in staggering detail over a low black horizon. Below right, a whitewashed farmstead shows a single warm window; centre-right, three friends lie on blankets across a bakkie's open load bed, faces faintly lit by distant ember-glow, arms pointing up. The star field owns the frame — top third is open sky dense with stars, still legible for UI. Portrait 9:16, hushed wonder.

lines.af: Lug só helder beteken môre skroei. Sit gerus nog 'n rukkie.
lines.en: Sky this clear means tomorrow's a scorcher. Stay a while.

lines.af: Niemand het 'huis toe' gesê nie. Niemand gaan ook nie.
lines.en: Nobody's called it a night. The night agrees.

rulings.imageConcept: Late clear night in the garden of a modern white-plaster-and-timber home: the low orange glow of dying coals warms the faces of four friends in camp chairs centre-right, blankets over knees, mugs in hand, mid-quiet-laughter. Above the dark rooflines the sky is pricked with sharp stars in crisp, windless air, a satellite trail faint. Top third open star field for UI. Portrait 9:16, the night nobody wants to end.

rulings.comment: Die nag pronk. Ons klap maar beleefd saam.

lines.af: Die maan doen vanaand oortyd oor die see.
lines.en: The moon is doing overtime over the Atlantic tonight.

lines.af: Die lug wys af. Ons klap maar beleefd saam.
lines.en: The sky is showing off. Politely, we're letting it.

rulings.imageConcept: Clear night on the balcony of a glass-and-steel Atlantic seaboard apartment: moonlight lays a silver path across a dead-calm sea, Lion's Head a clean dark silhouette against the star-salted sky. Centre-right, two siblings lean on the glass balustrade with steaming mugs, wrapped in hoodies, talking softly. The city's warm glow stays low and gentle beneath them. Top third open night sky for UI. Portrait 9:16, luminous stillness.

lines.af: Die damme drink eerste. Jy kry jou koffie tweede.
lines.en: The dams get their drink before you get your coffee. Know your place.

lines.af: Kaapse winter: die berg kry sy water terug, met rente.
lines.en: Cape winter: the mountain is getting its water back, with interest.

lines.af: Elke boer in die Boland glimlag nou in sy slaap.
lines.en: Every farmer in the Boland is smiling in their sleep right now.

rulings.imageConcept: First grey-gold light over a Stellenbosch wine farm in steady winter rain. A whitewashed Cape Dutch gable, wet and gleaming, stands centre-right of frame with a dripping old oak beside it; vine rows run off into soft mist behind. Rain is visible as fine silver streaks against the dark thatch. Top third is open rain-washed dawn sky, pale and luminous. Portrait 9:16, cinematic real-photo feel, celebratory not gloomy — the farm looks like it is being blessed, not soaked.

lines.af: In die Karoo is dit nie reën nie. Dis 'n verskyning.
lines.en: In the Karoo this isn't rain. It's a celebrity appearance.

lines.af: Selfs die skape staan stil vir hierdie een.
lines.en: Even the sheep are standing still for this one.

lines.af: Iemand het reggewens by die verjaarsdagkoek.
lines.en: Somebody's birthday-candle wish just paid out.

rulings.imageConcept: Dawn rain over the Karoo — the rarest show on earth. A corrugated tin-roof cottage with a deep stoep sits centre-right, lamplight still warm in one window; a windpomp stands further right, blades blurred with drizzle. Red earth in the foreground is darkening and glossy, low koppies dissolve into rain haze behind. Top third open with heavy pewter clouds cracked by one seam of dawn gold. Portrait 9:16, real-photo, awe-struck mood.

lines.af: Die reën op die dak het net amptelik snooze gedruk vir die hele land.
lines.en: That sound on the roof just hit snooze for the entire country.

lines.af: Vyf minute nog. Die weer het self so gesê.
lines.en: Five more minutes. The weather itself signed off on it.

rulings.imageConcept: Soft dawn drizzle streaming off a restored Victorian veranda, its white broekie-lace ironwork beaded with droplets, centre-right of frame. A steaming enamel mug rests on the wide railing beside a folded blanket on a riempie chair — someone has just stepped inside. Rain chains of water fall from the roof edge in the foreground. Behind, a leafy wet garden in blue-grey morning light. Top third open misty sky. Portrait 9:16, intimate, cosy, unhurried.

lines.af: Die hele stad het vergeet hoe om te bestuur. Ek het vergeet hoe om aan te trek.
lines.en: The whole city forgot how to drive. I forgot how to get dressed. We're even.

lines.af: Verkeersverslag: chaos. My verslag: koffie.
lines.en: Traffic report: chaos. My report: coffee.

lines.af: Werk-van-die-huis het nog nooit so geregverdig gevoel nie.
lines.en: Working from home has never felt this morally correct.

rulings.imageConcept: A modern white-plaster and timber home at dawn, floor-to-ceiling windows glowing amber against blue rain light. A woman in a gown stands at the glass centre-right, mug in both hands, watching sheets of rain comb the garden. Reflections double the warm light on the wet deck in the foreground. Top third is open brooding dawn sky. Portrait 9:16, aspirational, serene — the dry side of the glass as the best seat in the country.

lines.af: Een teug reënlug en skielik is almal in hierdie land 'n digter.
lines.en: One breath of rain air and suddenly the whole country is a poet.

lines.af: Petrichor is die Griekse woord. Ons woord is 'sjoe'.
lines.en: Petrichor is the Greek word for it. Our word is 'sjoe'.

rulings.imageConcept: Bo-Kaap at first light in winter rain: a row of jewel-coloured facades — teal, coral, saffron — glowing deeper for being wet, running up a cobbled street that climbs centre-right out of frame. Rain sparkles in the halo of a street lamp still burning. Signal Hill is a soft charcoal shape behind. Cobbles mirror the colours in the foreground. Top third open with silver rain clouds. Portrait 9:16, painterly-real, proud and beautiful.

lines.af: Damvlakke is die Kaap se eintlike Currie Cup.
lines.en: Dam levels are the Cape's real Currie Cup.

lines.af: Elke persentasiepunt kry sy eie familie-WhatsApp.
lines.en: Every percentage point gets its own family WhatsApp announcement.

lines.af: Theewaterskloof gaan vanoggend viraal in die groepsgesprek.
lines.en: Theewaterskloof is about to trend in the group chat.

rulings.imageConcept: Winelands dawn in proper winter rain: bare vine rows in the foreground channel silver runnels of water toward a distant gabled farmhouse centre-right, one window lit. Mountains behind are stacked ranks of blue mist. A farm dam glints at the right edge, visibly full, riffled by rain. Top third open with layered rain cloud catching a thin band of rose light. Portrait 9:16, real-photo, quiet triumph.

lines.af: Reën op 'n plaas is nie weer nie. Dis 'n salaris wat val.
lines.en: Rain on a farm isn't weather. It's a salary falling from the sky.

lines.af: Iewers doen 'n boer nou 'n klein dansie wat niemand mag sien nie.
lines.en: Somewhere a farmer is doing a small private dance nobody's allowed to see.

rulings.imageConcept: KwaZulu-Natal Midlands dawn, gentle rain over rolling emerald hills. A sandstone farmhouse with a red tin roof and deep veranda sits centre-right, chimney smoking softly into the drizzle. A gravel farm track curves in from the lower left, its puddles catching the pale sky. Mist pools in the valley folds behind. Top third open, luminous grey-lilac dawn. Portrait 9:16, real-photo, pastoral and rich.

rulings.comment: Die Hoeveldlug ná reën behoort in 'n botteltjie verkoop te word.

lines.af: Nat teer by sonsopkoms. Dis nie 'n reuk nie, dis 'n erfenis.
lines.en: Wet tar at sunrise. That's not a smell, that's heritage.

lines.af: Die Hooglandlug ná reën behoort in 'n botteltjie verkoop te word.
lines.en: Post-storm Highveld air should be bottled and sold overseas.

rulings.imageConcept: Joburg the morning after an overnight summer storm: a jacaranda-lined avenue at sunrise, wet tar steaming faintly as first sun slants across it. The street runs centre-right toward warm light; a runner in bright kit is a small figure mid-frame right, breath visible. Every leaf drips; the tar shines like poured glass. Top third open — rinsed, impossibly clear Highveld sky with the last shreds of storm cloud burning gold. Portrait 9:16, fresh, victorious.

lines.af: Joburg se reën hou dagboek: 14:00, stiptelik, vol drama.
lines.en: Joburg rain keeps a diary: 2pm sharp, maximum drama, no apologies.

lines.af: Twintig minute se opera, dan maak die son of niks gebeur het nie.
lines.en: Twenty minutes of opera, then the sun acts like nothing happened.

lines.af: Ander stede kry weer. Joburg kry 'n vertoning.
lines.en: Other cities get weather. Joburg gets a production.

rulings.imageConcept: Classic Joburg afternoon: from a rooftop terrace, an enormous anvil thunderhead stacks over the city skyline while a grey curtain of rain advances across the northern suburbs, half the frame already silver with falling water. The skyline cluster sits centre-right, sunlit for its last thirty seconds. Foreground terrace rail glistens with the first fat drops. Top third open — pure towering cloud drama. Portrait 9:16, epic, real-photo, theatrical not threatening.

lines.af: Twee druppels op die voorruit en die hele N1 se geheue is skoon gewas.
lines.en: Two drops on a windscreen and the whole N1 forgets everything it ever learned.

lines.af: Reën verander elke Suid-Afrikaanse bestuurder terug in 'n leerling.
lines.en: Rain turns every South African driver back into a learner. Hazards on, dignity off.

rulings.imageConcept: Three friends — diverse, twenties, laughing hard — dash across a wet Braamfontein street under one shared denim jacket held overhead, positioned centre-right. Summer downpour bounces off the tar around their sneakers; heritage brick facades and a striped café awning glow warm behind them through the rain. Motion blur in their stride, joy on every face. Top third open storm-bright sky between buildings. Portrait 9:16, candid energy, celebratory.

lines.af: Kapenaars hardloop nie weg van die reën nie. Hulle hardloop soontoe.
lines.en: Capetonians don't run from rain. They run towards it, cheering.

lines.af: Drie jaar se droogte-geheue en skielik is elke bui 'n lotto-wen.
lines.en: One drought in living memory and now every downpour is a lottery win.

rulings.imageConcept: Kalk Bay harbour in full winter weather: rain slanting across colourful fishing boats rocking at their moorings, a big Atlantic swell exploding white against the harbour wall right of centre. Two figures in yellow and red raincoats stand on the quay centre-right, coffee cups in hand, deliberately facing the spray. Fisherman's cottages climb the slope behind, windows warm. Top third open with muscular grey-silver cloud. Portrait 9:16, exhilarated, wind-fresh.

lines.af: 'n Padstalpastei in die reën is fynproewerskos. Moenie stry nie.
lines.en: A padstal pie in the rain is fine dining. This is not up for debate.

lines.af: Die reis kan wag. Die pastei kan nie.
lines.en: The road trip can wait. The pie cannot.

lines.af: Sommige oomblikke kies hulle eie afrit.
lines.en: Some moments choose their own off-ramp.

rulings.imageConcept: A beloved N1 padstal in the rain: red corrugated roof drumming, deep stoep with peach-crate shelves of preserves, rain sheeting off the gutter in a glass curtain. Two travellers — an older man and a young woman, family — sit at a stoep table centre-right with pies and moerkoffie, steam rising, bakkie parked nose-in beyond. Wet veld stretches flat behind into rain haze. Top third open pewter sky. Portrait 9:16, nostalgic, warm.

lines.af: Reën is net die weer se manier om te sê: bly waar die koffie is.
lines.en: Rain is just weather's way of saying stay where the coffee is.

lines.af: Alle afsprake is amptelik verskuif na 'wanneer dit opklaar'.
lines.en: All plans are officially moved to 'when it clears up'. Which is never. Shame.

rulings.imageConcept: Interior-out shot of a modern timber-and-glass coffee shop on a rainy midday: rain traces long ribbons down the big window that fills the frame's right side, city greenery blurred beyond. At the window bar centre-right, a barista leans over to a seated customer, both mid-laugh, flat whites between them, fern in a copper pot at the edge. Warm wood tones against cool rain light. Top third of the window shows open washed sky. Portrait 9:16, hygge with an SA accent.

lines.af: Jy ruik Hoëveldse reën voor jy hom sien. Dis die lokprent.
lines.en: You smell Highveld rain before you see it. That's the trailer.

lines.af: Die veld weet reeds. Die veld weet altyd eerste.
lines.en: The veld already knows. The veld always knows first.

rulings.imageConcept: Highveld grassland moments before the storm arrives: golden veld in strange green-gold pre-storm light, a red dirt road running toward a colossal charcoal rain shaft that hangs centre-right like a curtain being drawn across the horizon. A lone camelthorn tree stands sunlit against the darkness. Wind flattens the grass in the foreground. Top third open — half brilliant, half ink. Portrait 9:16, vast, electric anticipation.

lines.af: In die Kaap proe die wyn beter as die damme styg.
lines.en: In the Cape, wine genuinely tastes better when the dam levels are rising.

lines.af: Op die damvlakke! Elke bui is 'n rondte op die huis.
lines.en: To the dam levels! Every downpour is a round on the house.

rulings.imageConcept: Inside a Cape Dutch wine estate tasting room on a rainy winter afternoon: thick whitewashed window reveal frames vines and mountains smudged by rain, right of centre. Three friends — diverse, thirties — clink glasses of red at the deep windowsill, firelight from an unseen hearth warming their faces against the cool blue outside. Yellowwood beams overhead, brass lamp glowing. Top third holds the rain-washed view's pale sky. Portrait 9:16, generous, golden.

lines.af: Groot nuus: die plasse is oop vir besigheid.
lines.en: Breaking news: the puddles are open for business.

lines.af: Skoolskoene se grootste vyand het pas geland.
lines.en: School shoes' greatest enemy has just landed.

lines.af: Iemand se ma gaan iets sê. Dit was die moeite werd.
lines.en: Somebody's mom is going to have words. Worth it.

rulings.imageConcept: A leafy heritage street after a daytime shower: three neighbourhood kids — diverse, gumboots in yellow, red and blue — mid-leap over a huge mirror-flat puddle, frozen at the top of the jump, centre-right. Behind them a row of Victorian houses with broekie-lace verandas drips and gleams; an oak canopy sheds fat sun-caught drops. Spray fans from the lead boot. Top third open brightening sky. Portrait 9:16, pure kinetic joy.

lines.af: Joburg reën twintig minute en verf dan die lug asof niks gebeur het nie.
lines.en: Joburg rains for twenty minutes, then paints the sky like nothing happened.

lines.af: Die storm was die opvoering. Dít is die buiging.
lines.en: The storm was the performance. This is the bow.

rulings.imageConcept: Joburg twenty minutes after the storm: the sky is an outrageous wash of coral, violet and molten gold above a wet suburban avenue, every surface mirroring the colour. A man stands on his Victorian broekie-lace veranda centre-right, towel over one shoulder, just watching. Jacaranda trunks are black and glossy; the street runs with pink-lit water. Top third is entirely that scandalous sky. Portrait 9:16, cinematic afterglow.

lines.af: Skemer-reën draai die hele stad se volume saggies af.
lines.en: Dusk rain turns the whole city's volume down a notch.

lines.af: Die berg drink rustig. Die stad ook, waarskynlik.
lines.en: The mountain is having a quiet drink. So is half the city, probably.

rulings.imageConcept: Cape Town City Bowl at blue-hour dusk in soft steady winter rain, seen from inside a modern white-plaster and timber home: the huge window fills the right of frame, city lights smearing into golden bokeh through droplet-streaked glass, Lion's Head a soft silhouette. A wool blanket and open book rest on the window seat centre-right, reading lamp on. Top third of the view holds deep blue rain sky. Portrait 9:16, hushed, velvet-quiet.

lines.af: Weerlig in die verte, koffie in die hand — beste kanaal op televisie.
lines.en: Distant lightning and a warm mug: best channel on television.

lines.af: In die Karoo kyk jy reën soos ander mense rugby kyk.
lines.en: In the Karoo you watch rain the way other people watch rugby.

lines.af: Dis nog vyftig kilometer weg en die stoep is klaar vol.
lines.en: It's still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already sold out.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo dusk: distant rain shafts and a single fork of lightning over purple koppies on the horizon, while the foreground stays dry and still. A tin-roof cottage centre-right glows lamplit, an oupa and grandchild small on the stoep in silhouette, mugs in hand, facing the far-off show. First stars prick through a clear patch overhead. Top third open — indigo sky splitting between storm and starlight. Portrait 9:16, vast and tender.

lines.af: Reën op 'n sinkdak: die land se amptelike slaapliedjie.
lines.en: Rain on a tin roof: the official national lullaby.

lines.af: Geen slaap-app op aarde kan met 'n sinkdak meeding nie.
lines.en: No sleep app on earth can compete with a tin roof.

lines.af: Sit die foon neer. Die dak is besig om te praat.
lines.en: Put the phone down. The roof is talking.

rulings.imageConcept: Night rain on a Karoo farm cottage: the corrugated tin roof gleams under a hidden moon, rain caught as bright needles in the gold spill of one deep-set window, centre-right. A gnarled pepper tree drips beside the stoep; the rest of the world is soft blue-black. Smoke curls faintly from the chimney into the wet dark. Top third open night sky with rain-blurred stars behind cloud. Portrait 9:16, the cosiest image in the country.

lines.af: Die stad blink soos iets wat pas gewas is. Want dit is.
lines.en: The city is gleaming like it's just been washed. Because it has.

lines.af: Elke straatlig is nou 'n kunswerk. Dankie, reën.
lines.en: Every streetlight is suddenly an art installation. Rain's doing.

rulings.imageConcept: Cape Town city street at night in winter rain: warm restaurant light and street lamps stretch into long amber ribbons across drenched cobbles. A woman under a red umbrella crosses centre-right, boots flashing reflections, heritage facades with tall sash windows glowing behind her. Rain sparkles wherever light touches it. Top third open — deep charcoal sky bruised orange by city glow. Portrait 9:16, romantic-with-itself, alive.

lines.af: Gratis vuurwerke. Geen kaartjies. Beste sitplekke in die huis.
lines.en: Free fireworks, no tickets, best seats in the house.

lines.af: Die Hoëveld hou nie van subtiel nie en ons is dankbaar.
lines.en: The Highveld doesn't do subtle, and honestly we're grateful.

rulings.imageConcept: Highveld night storm from the covered balcony of a modern white-plaster and timber home: two friends in hoodies lean on the timber rail centre-right, backs half to camera, watching sheet lightning ignite a mountain of cloud on the horizon. Rain hammers just beyond the balcony's dry edge; the pool below flashes white with each strike. Top third open — the vast electric sky is the whole show. Portrait 9:16, front-row-seat energy.

lines.af: Buite gooi die weer sy beste vertoning. Binne wen Ouma nogsteeds.
lines.en: Weather's giving its big performance outside. Gran is still winning inside.

lines.af: Reënaand-reël: die hele huis trek na dieselfde kamer.
lines.en: Rainy night law: the whole house migrates to the same room.

lines.af: Niemand het beplan om bord te speel nie. Die reën het besluit.
lines.en: Nobody planned a games night. The rain decided.

rulings.imageConcept: Shot from the dark wet garden looking toward a Victorian home at night: rain streams off the broekie-lace veranda in bright threads lit from inside, where a bay window centre-right frames a family — gran, dad, two kids — around a board game, fire flickering gold behind them. Droplets on foreground leaves catch the window light like beads. Top third open rainy night sky above the roofline. Portrait 9:16, warmth seen from the cold, irresistible.

lines.af: Slaap lekker, damme. Julle het vandag hard gewerk.
lines.en: Sleep tight, dams. You worked hard today.

lines.af: Die Boland word in sy slaap natgelê en môre spog hy daaroor.
lines.en: The Boland is getting watered in its sleep and will absolutely brag about it tomorrow.

rulings.imageConcept: A Cape Dutch farmhouse gable at night in gentle winter rain, lit warmly by a single brass outside lamp mounted on the whitewashed wall, centre-right. Rain drifts through the cone of lamplight in slow gold flecks; a heavy oak branch hangs dripping into frame from the right. Beyond the gable, total soft darkness — farm-quiet. Top third open black-blue sky, faint cloud texture. Portrait 9:16, still, benedictory, deeply peaceful.

lines.af: Die son het snooze gedruk. Weer.
lines.en: The sun hit snooze again. Honestly? Same.

lines.af: Vroeë grys — soos die tee, laat dit net trek.
lines.en: Early grey. Like the tea, just let it steep.

lines.af: Die dag begin op eco-mode. Klim maar in.
lines.en: The day is starting on eco-mode. Hop in anyway.

rulings.imageConcept: Bo-Kaap at first light under a pearl-grey quilted sky, colour-washed facades in muted teal, pink and ochre stepping up the cobbled slope. A young Black woman in running gear stretches against a low wall centre-right, breath visible in the cool air. Soft, even dawn light flattens shadows; the street glistens faintly. Mood: quiet city waking gently. Top third is open cloud; the houses and runner occupy centre and right of frame.

lines.af: Die oggend kom sag in, amper soos 'n verskoning.
lines.en: Morning is coming in soft, almost like an apology.

lines.af: Onder dié lug is 'n tweede koffie nie 'n luukse nie, dis prosedure.
lines.en: Under this sky a second coffee isn't a luxury, it's procedure.

rulings.imageConcept: KZN Midlands dawn: a handsome stone farm cottage with a deep timber veranda, dew-heavy pastures rolling behind it, low unbroken cloud in soft silver bands. An Indian South African man in a fleece cradles a steaming enamel mug on the veranda steps, centre-right, looking out over the fields. Muted green-and-grey palette, gentle diffuse light, woodsmoke curl from the chimney. Top third pure layered cloud; cottage and figure anchor the right.

lines.af: Wasgoed-roulette: hang jy, of vou jy?
lines.en: Washing-line roulette: do you hang, or do you fold?

lines.af: Die app sê bewolk. Tannie se knie sê reën. Ons vertrou die knie.
lines.en: The app says cloudy. Aunty's knee says rain. We trust the knee.

lines.af: Kans op reën: miskien. Kans dat almal daaroor praat: 100%.
lines.en: Chance of rain: maybe. Chance of everyone discussing it: 100%.

rulings.imageConcept: Sea Point promenade midday under a high silver overcast, the Atlantic a sheet of hammered pewter. Two friends — a coloured woman in a bright coat and a Black man in a hoodie — walk and laugh centre-right along the railing, palm trees bending gently behind them. Clean diffuse light, no harsh shadows, the pale lighthouse-red of a distant bench for colour. Top third all soft cloud; figures and railing hold centre-right.

lines.af: Die lug het ons boodskap gelees en nie geantwoord nie.
lines.en: The sky has left the whole country on read.

lines.af: Dis nie reënweer nie, dis dreigweer.
lines.en: Not rain weather. Threatening-to-rain weather. Big difference.

lines.af: Die son is agter die wolke besig met admin. Hy kom nou-nou.
lines.en: The sun is behind the clouds doing admin. Back shortly.

rulings.imageConcept: Stellenbosch wine estate courtyard under a rolling grey ceiling: a whitewashed Cape Dutch manor with an ornate gable, bare winter oaks, wet-look cobbles. Three colleagues — a Black woman, a white man, a coloured man — share a long wooden table with coffee, mid-conversation, centre-right. Diffuse light makes the white plaster glow against the slate sky. Mood: unhurried, grand, cosy. Top third open cloud above the gable; table group right of centre.

lines.af: Hoëveldse wolke: baie lokprent, min fliek.
lines.en: Highveld clouds: all trailer, no movie.

lines.af: Die wolke hou 'n vergadering en ons is nie genooi nie.
lines.en: The clouds are in a meeting and we're not on the invite.

lines.af: Selfs die lug lyk of hy vandag van die huis af wou werk.
lines.en: Even the sky looks like it applied to work from home today.

rulings.imageConcept: Sandton rooftop garden at midday: glass-and-steel towers rising into a dramatic grey Highveld cloud deck, sculptural aloes and indigenous grasses in planters. A young Black professional woman leans on the glass balustrade centre-right, jacket collar up, city sprawling behind. Steely blues and greys with warm aloe orange accents. Big brooding sky fills the open top third; towers and figure stacked centre-right.

lines.af: Grys is ook 'n kleur, sê my ma. Vandag glo ek haar.
lines.en: Grey is also a colour, says my ma. Today I believe her.

lines.af: Die son buffer nog. Moenie die bladsy verfris nie.
lines.en: The sun is buffering. Do not refresh the page.

lines.af: 'Ons kyk hoe dit lyk' — Suid-Afrika se amptelike RSVP.
lines.en: 'We'll see how it looks' — South Africa's official RSVP.

rulings.imageConcept: Kalk Bay harbour on a still grey day: wooden fishing boats in soft primary colours rocking on glassy water, Victorian shopfronts with broekie-lace ironwork rising behind the quay. Two friends — an older coloured man and his younger sister — sip takeaway coffee on the harbour wall, centre-right, gulls wheeling. Flat silver light, gentle reflections. False Bay dissolves into cloud. Top third open sky; boats and figures centre-right.

lines.af: 50/50-weer, en ons is 100% klaar aan die gang.
lines.en: The weather is 50/50. We are 100% going anyway.

lines.af: Bewolk is nie 'n rede om te kanselleer nie, dis atmosfeer.
lines.en: Overcast isn't a cancellation, it's ambience.

rulings.imageConcept: Drakensberg foothills trail under a layered cloud ceiling, the Amphitheatre's basalt wall fading in and out of grey. Two siblings — Black South African, one in a red beanie — stride up a grassy ridge path centre-right, daypacks on, mid-laugh. Moody greens and slate blues, light soft and even, grass moving in a light breeze. Vast open cloud fills the top third; hikers and ridge line pull right.

lines.af: Duvet-weer op 'n werksdag. Sterkte, Mzansi.
lines.en: Duvet weather on a workday. Strength, Mzansi.

lines.af: Die familiegroep sê reën. Die lug weier kommentaar.
lines.en: The family group says rain. The sky has declined to comment.

rulings.imageConcept: Umhlanga promenade on a warm grey KZN day: the sculptural white whalebone pier arcs over a muted jade sea, subtropical milkwoods glossy in the flat light. A young Indian South African woman jogs along the walkway centre-right, earphones in, ponytail mid-swing. Humid pastel greys with that warm Durban softness — grey but never cold. Top third is open marine cloud; pier and jogger balance centre-right.

lines.af: Daai wolke beteken swaai-boulwerk. Vra enige oom by die hek.
lines.en: Clouds like these mean swing bowling. Ask any oom at the gate.

lines.af: Die tjops weet nie dis bewolk nie. Die braai gaan voort.
lines.en: The chops don't know it's cloudy. The braai proceeds.

lines.af: Die lug dra sy onderhoudspak: grys, netjies, sê niks.
lines.en: The sky is in its interview suit: grey, neat, giving nothing away.

rulings.imageConcept: Franschhoek valley in winter: neat pruned vine rows in russet and umber running toward blue-grey mountains capped with heavy cloud. Three friends — a white woman, a Black man, a coloured woman — walk a farm track between the rows centre-right, jackets and scarves, one gesturing at the sky. A whitewashed werf building with a simple gable sits far right. Rich earthy tones under silver light; open cloud bank across the top third.

lines.af: Naweek-grys: amptelike toestemming om niks te doen nie.
lines.en: Weekend grey: official permission to do absolutely nothing.

lines.af: Dis tee-en-beskuit-weer, en dit is nie onderhandelbaar nie.
lines.en: It's rusk-dunking weather, and that is not up for debate.

lines.af: Wolke rol in soos familie — sonder om eers te bel.
lines.en: Clouds rolling in like family — no phone call first.

rulings.imageConcept: Clarens village green under a soft Free State cloud blanket: honey-coloured sandstone buildings with deep verandas edge the square, bare winter poplars in pale gold. Two neighbours — an older white woman and a young Basotho man — chat over the fence of a stone cottage garden, centre-right, wrapped in blankets and beanies. Warm stone against cool grey sky, smoke from a chimney. Top third open cloud; square recedes left, people right.

lines.af: Gratis ateljee-beligting vandag. Vat die selfie.
lines.en: Free studio lighting today. Take the selfie.

lines.af: Die wolke oefen heeldag vir 'n storm wat nooit vir die oudisie opdaag nie.
lines.en: These clouds have rehearsed a storm all day. It never shows up for the audition.

lines.af: Grys dag is bak-dag. Iemand se kombuis ruik nou al lekker.
lines.en: Grey day equals baking day. Somebody's kitchen already smells amazing.

rulings.imageConcept: Paternoster mid-morning: whitewashed fisherman-style cottages with crisp lime-washed walls and slate-blue shutters scattered along a wide empty beach, the Atlantic flat and milky under an even grey lid. A coloured woman in a chunky knit walks a golden retriever at the waterline, centre-right, wind lifting her scarf. Minimalist palette — white, bone, grey-blue. Serene, spacious. Top third all cloud; cottages and walker hold the right half.

lines.af: Die wolke het vanaand se sonsondergang agter 'n betaalmuur gesit.
lines.en: Tonight's sunset is behind a paywall.

lines.af: Geen sonsondergangfoto's nie — die hemel se privaatheid-instellings is aan.
lines.en: No sunset pics tonight. The sky's privacy settings are on.

rulings.imageConcept: Camps Bay at dusk, the Twelve Apostles dissolving into a mauve-grey cloud bank, the last light a thin pale seam on the horizon. Three friends — diverse Mzansi twenty-somethings — sit on the giant granite boulders centre-right, hoods up, sharing a flask. The sea is dark satin, the beach empty and clean. Muted lilac, slate and charcoal tones. Top third heavy soft cloud; boulders and figures cluster right.

lines.af: Die straatligte gaan vroeg aan en niemand kla nie.
lines.en: Streetlights on early tonight, and not a single complaint.

lines.af: Die son het uitgeklok sonder om te groet. Onbeskof, maar relatable.
lines.en: The sun clocked out without saying bye. Rude, but relatable.

rulings.imageConcept: Melville, Johannesburg at dusk: a row of restored Victorian houses with white broekie-lace verandas, streetlights just flickering on amber under a bruised grey sky. An older Black man waters pavement roses at his gate centre-right while a neighbour waves from next door's stoep. Warm window glow against cool violet-grey cloud. Nostalgic, safe, golden-hour-without-the-gold. Top third open cloud; houses and figures fill centre-right.

lines.af: Die dag gaan uit soos 'n kers, nie 'n vuurwerk nie. Respek.
lines.en: The day is going out like a candle, not a firework. Respect.

lines.af: Die wolke bly oor vir aandete, lyk dit.
lines.en: Looks like the clouds are staying for supper.

rulings.imageConcept: Constantia wine estate at dusk: a whitewashed Cape Dutch manor glowing softly between centuries-old oaks, lawns rolling toward vineyards under a dense pewter sky going charcoal. Two colleagues — a Black woman and a white woman in winter coats — stroll the oak avenue centre-right, deep in conversation. Lanterns warm along the werf wall. Deep greens, charcoal, candle-amber. Top third open darkening cloud; manor and walkers centre-right.

lines.af: Die dag eindig soos 'n voicenote wat net skielik ophou.
lines.en: The day is ending like a voicenote that just cuts off mid-

lines.af: Skemer op mute vanaand. Die aand het nogtans opgedaag.
lines.en: Dusk is on mute tonight. The evening showed up anyway.

rulings.imageConcept: Durban Golden Mile at dusk under a warm smoky-grey sky, the pier a dark elegant silhouette over a soft silver surf line. A young Zulu man skateboards slowly along the wide promenade centre-right, boardwalk lamps blinking on, palms swaying. The city's warm lights smudge into the cloud behind him. Humid greys, teal shadows, sodium-lamp amber. Relaxed end-of-day energy. Top third open cloud; pier and skater centre-right.

rulings.comment: Die hemel draai die dimmer stadig af. Netjies.

lines.af: Die hemel draai die dimmer stadig af. Klas.
lines.en: The sky is easing the dimmer down slowly. Classy.

lines.af: Môre se son is klaar gebook. Ontspan.
lines.en: Tomorrow's sun is already booked. Relax.

rulings.imageConcept: Graaff-Reinet at dusk: a proud Karoo Victorian home, white walls and intricate broekie-lace veranda, warm lamplight in the sash windows under a vast grey-violet Karoo sky. An older coloured woman and her adult son carry firewood up the garden path, centre-right, sharing a joke. Spekboom hedge, gravel, deep quiet. The cloud deck glows faintly where the sun gave up. Top third enormous open sky; house and pair right.

lines.af: Die dag teken af sonder drama. Ons vat dit.
lines.en: The day is logging off without drama. We'll take that.

lines.af: Vanaand se sonsondergang is 'n binnenshuise geleentheid.
lines.en: Tonight's sunset is an indoors-only event.

rulings.imageConcept: Knysna lagoon at dusk: still steel-blue water mirroring a low grey ceiling, modern timber-and-glass waterfront homes glowing warm along the shore, the Heads a dark gate in the distance. A Black father and his teenage daughter pack up fishing rods on a wooden jetty centre-right, unbothered by the fading light. Soft blues, wet-wood browns, honey window light. Peaceful, unhurried. Top third open cloud; jetty and figures centre-right.

lines.af: Verkeer onder, wolkverkeer bo. Almal kruip stadig huis toe.
lines.en: Traffic below, cloud traffic above. Everyone is crawling home.

lines.af: Die son het vroeg gery — 'n 'ander verpligting', glo.
lines.en: The sun ducked out early — 'another commitment', apparently.

rulings.imageConcept: Sandton at dusk from a rooftop terrace: glass-and-steel towers lighting up floor by floor under a heavy charcoal cloud deck, ribbons of headlights threading the streets far below. Two colleagues — an Indian South African man and a Black woman, laptop bags down — lean on the parapet with takeaway coffees, centre-right, watching the city switch shifts. Cool steel blues cut by warm office gold. Top third brooding open cloud.

lines.af: Geen kleure in die lug vanaand nie, net skakerings van rustig.
lines.en: No colours in the sky tonight, just shades of calm.

lines.af: Die aand kom binne op sokkies.
lines.en: The evening is tiptoeing in on socks.

rulings.imageConcept: Chintsa, Wild Coast at dusk: a boutique timber lodge deck perched above dune forest, the long beach curving away under a seamless dove-grey sky, sea and horizon melting together. Two friends — a Xhosa woman and a white man in thick jerseys — sit on the deck steps with steaming rooibos mugs, centre-right, blankets over knees. Muted greens, driftwood greys, soft lamp glow. Deep calm. Top third open unbroken cloud.

lines.af: Die sterre het verskoning gestuur vir vanaand se vergadering.
lines.en: The stars sent their apologies for tonight's meeting.

lines.af: Selfs die maan werk vanaand van die huis af.
lines.en: Even the moon is working from home tonight.

rulings.imageConcept: Cape Town city bowl at night from Signal Hill: a soft lid of low cloud sealing the sky, the city's amber and white lights glittering beneath it, Table Mountain a huge dark presence right of frame. A small group of three friends sit on the grassy slope with a thermos, centre-right, city glow on their faces. Deep navy and charcoal with warm gold. Top third velvety cloud, faintly lit from below.

lines.af: Die Melkweg vat 'n aand af. Selfs sterre het grense.
lines.en: The Milky Way took the night off. Even stars have boundaries.

lines.af: Niks sterre om te tel nie — tel skape, of seëninge. Jou keuse.
lines.en: No stars to count tonight. Count sheep or blessings, dealer's choice.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo farmstead at night: a Victorian homestead with a lamplit broekie-lace veranda, warm light pooling on the gravel werf, windpump a still silhouette against a starless charcoal sky. An older white farmer and his adult Black foreman-friend sit on veranda chairs with mugs, mid-story, centre-right. Ink blues, lantern amber, absolute stillness. The huge dark cloud deck fills the open top third; house and pair anchor the right.

lines.af: Die lug is oorgetrek. Jou bed ook. Toeval? Nooit.
lines.en: The sky is under the covers. Yours are waiting. Coincidence? Never.

lines.af: Die wolke het die groot lig afgesit. Gaan slaap, Mzansi.
lines.en: The clouds switched off the big light. Go to bed, Mzansi.

rulings.imageConcept: Pretoria east at night: a modern white-plaster-and-timber home with clean horizontal lines, warm light spilling from double-volume windows onto a manicured indigenous garden, the sky above a felt-thick blanket of dark grey cloud. A Black woman in a gown carries two mugs of hot chocolate across the deck toward the glass doors, centre-right. Charcoal sky, cream walls, honey light. Snug, aspirational, safe. Top third open heavy cloud.

lines.af: Geen sterre nie, maar die buurt se honde het steeds opinies.
