lines.en: No stars tonight, but the neighbourhood dogs still have opinions.

lines.af: Die hemel is op vliegtuigmodus. Geen kennisgewings tot môre nie.
lines.en: The sky is on aeroplane mode. No notifications till morning.

rulings.imageConcept: Durban beachfront at night under a warm overcast: lamplit promenade curving along a dark, softly breathing sea, palm fronds moving lazily, the pier's silhouette catching stray light. Two friends — an Indian South African woman and a Zulu woman — share hot chips on a bench centre-right, laughing at something on a phone held between them, screen glow on their faces. Humid navy greys and sodium amber. Top third open low cloud.

lines.af: Die maan het 'n 'moenie steur nie'-bordjie opgehang.
lines.en: The moon has hung out a do-not-disturb sign.

lines.af: Die hemel se gordyne is toe. Privaatheid, asseblief.
lines.en: The sky's curtains are drawn. Privacy, please.

rulings.imageConcept: A Stellenbosch werf at night: lantern light washing a Cape Dutch gable in soft gold, ancient oak branches black overhead, cobbles glinting, the sky beyond a dense moonless grey-black. A coloured woman locks up the old cellar door while her brother waits with the bakkie keys, centre-right, both in jackets, easy end-of-shift smiles. Deep greens, iron black, lamplight gold. Historic and hushed. Top third open dark cloud above the gable.

lines.af: Die maan het sein, net geen strepies vanaand nie.
lines.en: The moon has signal tonight, just no bars.

lines.af: Môre is 'n nuwe onderhandeling met die weer. Vanaand rus ons.
lines.en: Tomorrow is a fresh negotiation with the weather. Tonight we rest.

rulings.imageConcept: Rosebank rooftop at night: glass-and-steel apartment towers glowing warm against a city-lit cloud base, planters of wild grasses shivering in a light breeze. A young coloured man in a puffer jacket leans back in a deck chair centre-right, headphones on, one foot on the parapet planter, completely at peace. The cloud ceiling holds the city's amber like a lampshade. Modern, moody, comfortable. Top third open glowing cloud.

lines.af: Die nag het 'n weighted blanket oor alles kom gooi.
lines.en: The night has thrown a weighted blanket over everything.

lines.af: Nagwolke is die hemel se manier van sê: ons praat môre weer.
lines.en: Night clouds are the sky's way of saying: let's talk tomorrow.

rulings.imageConcept: KZN Midlands stone terrace late at night: a low stone farmhouse wall, wicker chairs with wool blankets, a single storm lantern, mist-free darkness rolling away over invisible hills under a total cloud blackout. Three friends — diverse Mzansi thirty-somethings — sit wrapped up close, faces warm in lantern light, one mid-anecdote with hands raised, centre-right. Charcoal and amber, wood and wool textures. Top third pure dark cloud.

lines.af: Iewers is 'n braai op sy laaste kole, geen sterre nie — die gesels dra die aand.
lines.en: Somewhere a braai is down to its last coals, no stars — the conversation carries the night.

lines.af: Nagskof-wolke: hulle hou net die plek warm tot die son terug is.
lines.en: Night-shift clouds: just keeping the place warm till the sun gets back.

rulings.imageConcept: Sea Point promenade at night: elegant lamp posts marching along the railing, the Atlantic a vast black-silver murmur, Lion's Head a soft dark shape lost in low cloud. A Black man walks his small scruffy dog past the lit rail, centre-right, beanie and scarf, unhurried. Wet-look paving reflects lamp gold into blue-black shadow. Safe, cinematic, quiet. Top third open starless cloud; walker and lamps hold the right.

lines.af: Die hemel het die sterre op stil gesit. Hulle is nog daar, belowe.
lines.en: The sky put the stars on silent. They're still up there, promise.

lines.af: Slaapweer van die boonste rak. Die wolke het seker gemaak.
lines.en: Top-shelf sleeping weather. The clouds made sure of it.

rulings.imageConcept: Pringle Bay at night: whitewashed modern coastal cottages with timber shutters scattered between fynbos and dunes, one glowing warm, the ocean a distant hush, mountains a black cut-out beneath an unbroken cloud lid. An older Black woman on her lit stoep pours tea for her granddaughter, both in thick socks and blankets, centre-right. Bone-white walls, ink sky, candle amber. Utterly still. Top third open dark cloud.

lines.af: Die huis is kouer binne as buite. Argitektuur is 'n mooi ding.
lines.en: The house is colder inside than outside. Architecture is a beautiful thing.

lines.af: Eerste een op moet die ketel aansit. Dis die wet.
lines.en: First one up puts the kettle on. That's the law.

lines.af: Vyf minute nog. Oukei tien. Oukei tot die son op die bed val.
lines.en: Five more minutes. Okay ten. Okay until the sun reaches the bed.

rulings.imageConcept: A thatched Karoo cottage at first light, whitewashed walls glowing peach against a frost-silvered plain, a thin ribbon of woodsmoke rising from the chimney. A single bedroom window lit warm gold. Sparse frosted shrubs in the near ground catch low sun. Composition: vast pale-pink dawn sky fills the open top third; the cottage sits centre-right in the lower half, smoke drifting right.

lines.af: Die hond het by die voordeur gekyk, omgedraai, en teruggegaan bed toe. Wys jou.
lines.en: The dog looked out the front door, turned around, and went back to bed. Says it all.

lines.af: Ryp op die gras, ryp op die bakkie, ryp op my moed.
lines.en: Frost on the grass, frost on the bakkie, frost on my will to live.

lines.af: Mooiste tyd van die dag. Sê die mense wat binne bly.
lines.en: Most beautiful time of day. Say the people who stay inside.

rulings.imageConcept: Highveld winter dawn: a frost-white grassland rolling to the horizon, one flat-topped acacia catching the first orange light, ground mist pooling in the low ground. A gravel farm track runs in from the right edge toward the tree. Everything crystalline and still. Composition: enormous clear apricot sky, top third completely open; the acacia stands centre-right on the frost line.

lines.af: Ketel gekook vir die koffie. Ketel weer gekook vir die hande.
lines.en: Boiled the kettle for the coffee. Boiled it again for my hands.

lines.af: As die rook reguit op staan, is dit amptelik te koud vir grappies.
lines.en: When the smoke rises dead straight, it's officially too cold for jokes.

lines.af: Die koffie word koud tussen die ketel en die tafel. Respekteer die spoed.
lines.en: The coffee goes cold between the kettle and the table. Respect the pace required.

rulings.imageConcept: A Midlands stone farmhouse at dawn, dry-stone walls and a steep slate roof, chimney smoke rising dead straight into windless cold air. Frost-dusted paddock in front, two plain unbranded enamel mugs steaming on the low garden wall as if just set down. Soft blue-gold light. Composition: high open sky in the top third; the farmhouse and mugs sit centre-right, smoke column leading the eye up.

lines.af: Kaapse koue is nat koue. Dit klim in jou bene en pak uit.
lines.en: Cape cold is wet cold. It moves into your bones and unpacks.

lines.af: Die kamerjas is nou dagdrag. Ons noem dit winter couture.
lines.en: The gown is daywear now. We're calling it winter couture.

lines.af: Iewers is daar mense wat nou gaan draf. Sterkte vir hulle.
lines.en: Somewhere out there people are going for a run right now. Strength to them.

rulings.imageConcept: Cape winelands dawn after overnight rain: bare winter vineyard rows glistening wet, low mist hugging the valley floor, a gabled Cape Dutch manor house pale in the half-light with one warm window. Puddles in the farm road mirror a bruised lilac sky. Composition: moody clearing sky holds the open top third; the manor and vine rows anchor centre-right, road entering from bottom right.

lines.af: Sneeu op die berge beteken een ding: almal gaan dit vandag vir jou sê.
lines.en: Snow on the mountains means one thing: everyone is going to tell you about it today.

lines.af: Uit die bed uit was die moeilikste bergklim van die dag.
lines.en: Getting out of bed was the hardest summit of the day.

lines.af: Twee duvets en 'n gebed. So oorleef ons.
lines.en: Two duvets and a prayer. That's the system.

rulings.imageConcept: Drakensberg dawn: snow-dusted peaks turning rose-gold, a stone-and-thatch mountain lodge small in the mid-ground with lights on, frost sparkling on the lawn between. A woman in a thick plain jersey stands at the veranda rail with a steaming mug, back mostly to camera, taking it in. Composition: peaks and glowing sky own the open top third; lodge and figure sit centre-right.

lines.af: Die teëls is 'n ekstreme sport voor agtuur.
lines.en: The tiles are an extreme sport before 8am.

lines.af: Van die bed na die kombuis is 'n naelloop. Daar is nie tyd vir grasie nie.
lines.en: Bed to kitchen is a sprint event. There is no time for grace.

lines.af: Binne-in daardie huis is dit ook koud. Moenie jou laat flous nie.
lines.en: It's cold inside that house too. Don't be fooled.

rulings.imageConcept: A modern white-plaster and timber home at dawn, floor-to-ceiling window glowing amber from a fireplace inside, garden furniture outside rimmed with frost. Through the glass, softly out of focus, a man in a blanket carries two mugs toward a sofa where a child waits. Composition: cold blue pre-sun sky open across the top third; the warm window and figures sit centre-right, frost catching first light bottom left.

lines.af: Die son is uit. Dit beteken niks. Die son jok.
lines.en: The sun is out. It means nothing. The sun is lying.

lines.af: Mooiste blou lug in die land, en dit voel soos 'n yskas met uitsig.
lines.en: Prettiest blue sky in the country, and it feels like a fridge with a view.

lines.af: Highveld winter: sonbrand en verkluiming op dieselfde dag moontlik.
lines.en: Highveld winter: sunburn and frostbite achievable on the same day.

rulings.imageConcept: Bright Highveld winter midday: bleached golden grassland under a hard cloudless blue sky, a rusted-silver windpump turning slowly, cattle grazing far right. The light is brilliant but the scene reads crisp and dry, long shadows even at noon. Composition: deep flawless blue sky fills the open top third; the windpump stands centre-right against the gold grass.

lines.af: Die aalwyne blom. Hulle is die enigstes wat die winter geniet.
lines.en: The aloes are blooming. They're the only ones enjoying winter.

lines.af: Selfs die plante het besluit oranje is die antwoord op koue.
lines.en: Even the plants have decided orange is the answer to cold.

lines.af: Trek aan soos 'n aalwyn: lae op lae, en bly staan.
lines.en: Dress like an aloe: layers on layers, and refuse to fall over.

rulings.imageConcept: Winter aloes in full flame-orange bloom on a rocky Eastern Cape hillside under clear cold light, a valley of khaki bush rolling away behind them. A sugarbird perches on the tallest bloom. Everything sharp, saturated, dry-season beautiful. Composition: pale winter-blue sky holds the open top third; the tallest aloe cluster rises centre-right, hillside falling away to the left.

lines.af: Die strand is nou net vir die dapperes en die honde.
lines.en: The beach belongs to the brave and the dogs now.

lines.af: Winterlug: die berge lyk naby genoeg om aan te raak. Steeds te koud om te swem.
lines.en: Winter air: the mountains look close enough to touch. Still too cold to swim.

lines.af: Iemand gaan nou-nou sê 'verfrissend'. Moenie hulle glo nie.
lines.en: Someone is about to say 'refreshing'. Do not believe them.

rulings.imageConcept: Strand beachfront on a cold clear winter day: long empty white beach, glassy small surf, the Helderberg mountains crisp and close in rare washed-clean air. Two friends in beanies and thick plain jackets walk the waterline with a delighted spaniel, mid-ground right. Composition: enormous rinsed-blue sky open across the top third; walkers and mountains anchored centre-right.

lines.af: Een kombers, twee mense. Onderhandelinge duur voort.
lines.en: One blanket, two people. Negotiations are ongoing.

lines.af: 'n Beskuitjie doop jy stadig in koue weer. Dis nie 'n reël nie, dis 'n kultuur.
lines.en: You dunk a rusk slowly in cold weather. It's not a rule, it's a culture.

lines.af: Die stoep is die warmste kamer in die huis. Dink daaroor.
lines.en: The stoep is the warmest room in the house. Sit with that.

rulings.imageConcept: A Victorian house with white lacework veranda in a leafy country town, bare winter oaks lining the street, cold midday sun throwing long soft shadows across the lawn. An older man and his granddaughter sit on the veranda step wrapped in one big plain checked blanket, sharing rusks from a tin. Composition: bright pale sky and bare branches keep the top third open; veranda and pair sit centre-right.

lines.af: Sneeu op die berge. Elke familiegroep het nou dieselfde foto.
lines.en: Snow on the mountains. Every family WhatsApp group now has the same photo.

lines.af: Naby genoeg om te bewonder, ver genoeg om nie te skep nie. Perfek.
lines.en: Close enough to admire, far enough that you don't have to shovel it. Perfect.

lines.af: Iemand ry nou soontoe 'om te gaan kyk'. Hulle gaan in die verkeer sit.
lines.en: Someone is driving up there 'just to look'. They are going to sit in traffic.

rulings.imageConcept: Franschhoek valley in winter: fresh snow on the high Groot Drakenstein peaks, dark wet vineyards below, a white Cape Dutch gable bright against stormy-clean light. A break in clouds spotlights the snow. Wet road sheen in the foreground. Composition: dramatic clearing sky and snowy peaks fill the open top third; the gabled homestead sits centre-right among the vine rows.

lines.af: Die hond het die beste plek gevat. Niemand is dapper genoeg om te skuif nie.
lines.en: The dog took the best spot. Nobody is brave enough to move him.

lines.af: Vuur aan voor twaalf. Ons speel nie meer nie.
lines.en: Fire lit before noon. We are no longer playing games.

lines.af: Die groot debat: sit die verwarmer óók aan, of is ons nie gemaak van geld nie?
lines.en: The great debate: do we switch the heater on too, or are we not made of money?

rulings.imageConcept: Interior of a modern white-plaster and timber living room at midday: fireplace roaring, big window showing a cold bright garden beyond, a golden retriever occupying the entire prime rug spot in front of the flames. Three mugs on the coffee table suggest humans displaced to the sofa. Composition: window light and high timber ceiling keep the top third airy and open; fire and dog sit centre-right.

lines.af: So koud dat die ryp middagete gebly het.
lines.en: So cold the frost stayed for lunch.

lines.af: Forelweer. Vir die vis is dit lekker. Vir die visserman is dit karakterbou.
lines.en: Trout weather. Lovely for the fish. Character-building for the fisherman.

lines.af: Die water lyk soos glas. Dit voel soos ys. Moenie eksperimenteer nie.
lines.en: The water looks like glass. It feels like ice. Do not run the experiment.

rulings.imageConcept: Dullstroom trout-country winter day: a mirror-still dam reflecting a hard blue sky, frost lingering in the shadowed reeds even at midday, a stone-and-timber fishing cottage with smoking chimney on the far bank. A heron stands motionless mid-right. Composition: vast clean sky owns the open top third; cottage and heron reflections anchored centre-right on the waterline.

lines.af: Jou asem maak wolkies. Gratis spesiale effekte, hele winter lank.
lines.en: Your breath is making clouds. Free special effects, all winter long.

lines.af: Vrystaat-koue: droog, eerlik, en persoonlik.
lines.en: Free State cold: dry, honest, and personal.

lines.af: Die uitsig is die beloning. Die gevoel in jou vingers kom later terug.
lines.en: The view is the reward. The feeling in your fingers returns later.

rulings.imageConcept: Clarens sandstone cliffs glowing ochre in cold clear light, poplar trees bare and golden-stemmed along a stream, the little town's rooftops tucked below the massif. A hiker in a red beanie and plain fleece pauses on a path mid-right, breath visible. Composition: towering cliffs and washed blue sky keep the top third open; hiker and poplars sit centre-right along the stream line.

lines.af: Nat koue by die see: die soort wat deur vier lae en 'n goeie humeur trek.
lines.en: Wet sea cold: the kind that gets through four layers and a good mood.

lines.af: Vandag is 'n vis-en-tjips-uit-die-papier dag. Dokter se orders.
lines.en: Today is a fish-and-chips-out-the-paper day. Doctor's orders.

lines.af: Die meeue klink kwaad. Dieselfde, meeue. Dieselfde.
lines.en: The seagulls sound furious about it. Same, seagulls. Same.

rulings.imageConcept: Kalk Bay harbour on a cold grey-bright winter day: colourful wooden fishing boats rocking on dark green swell, spray bursting white off the harbour wall, gulls hanging in the wind. Two fishermen in yellow oilskins coil rope on the quay, mid-right. Mountains moody behind. Composition: heavy silver sky holds the open top third; boats and fishermen cluster centre-right against the harbour wall.

lines.af: Padstal-pannekoek in die winter is nie 'n versnapering nie, dis noodhulp.
lines.en: Padstal pancakes in winter aren't a snack, they're first aid.

lines.af: Die Karoo het twee seisoene: warm genoeg om te kla, en dit.
lines.en: The Karoo has two seasons: hot enough to complain about, and this.

lines.af: Kaneelsuiker los meer probleme op as wat mense wil erken.
lines.en: Cinnamon sugar solves more problems than people are willing to admit.

rulings.imageConcept: A Karoo padstal with a wide farm veranda at midday: thatched roof, whitewashed pillars, plain unbranded jam jars and pumpkins on a wooden table, endless flat winter veld shimmering cold and gold beyond. A woman in an apron sets down a tray of steaming pancakes for two travellers, all mid-right. Composition: huge empty Karoo sky open across the top third; veranda scene sits centre-right.

rulings.comment: Sit in die son, kla oor die koue. Nasionale sport.

lines.af: Joburg-winter: jas in die oggend, T-hemp teen twee, jas weer teen vier.
lines.en: Joburg winter: jacket in the morning, T-shirt by two, jacket again by four.

lines.af: Die fles tee is die ware sosiale netwerk.
lines.en: The flask of tea is the original social network.

lines.af: Sit in die son, klae oor die koue. Nasionale sport.
lines.en: Sitting in the sun, complaining about the cold. National sport.

rulings.imageConcept: Soweto's Orlando Towers in the distance under a crisp winter sky, seen across a green park where three friends in puffer jackets and beanies share a flask of tea on a bench, laughing, mid-right. Winter grass gold at their feet, jacaranda branches bare overhead framing without covering the sky. Composition: cold clean blue sky fills the open top third; the bench trio anchors centre-right.

lines.af: Die berge het reën gekry en dink hulle is nou in Skotland.
lines.en: The mountains got rain and now think they're in Scotland.

lines.af: Rooibos is gebore vir presies hierdie weer. Drink dit waar dit groei.
lines.en: Rooibos was born for exactly this weather. Drink it where it grows.

lines.af: Koue plus mooi is 'n eerlike transaksie. Ons vat dit.
lines.en: Cold plus beautiful is an honest trade. We'll take it.

rulings.imageConcept: Cederberg winter day after rain: wet orange sandstone formations steaming faintly in weak sun, rooibos-green scrub sparkling, dramatic torn clouds racing overhead. A small stone cottage with a smoking chimney shelters in a kloof, mid-right. Puddled 4x4 track leads in from bottom right. Composition: wild moving sky owns the open top third; rock formations and cottage stack centre-right.

lines.af: Die wasgoed gaan nie droog word nie. Ons hang dit op vir die hoop.
lines.en: The washing is not going to dry. We hang it up for hope.

lines.af: Die worshond het 'n trui. Hy het dit nie gevra nie, maar hy dra dit met waardigheid.
lines.en: The sausage dog has a jersey. He didn't ask for it, but he wears it with dignity.

lines.af: Winterson: al die lig, nul van die hitte. Mooi probeer, son.
lines.en: Winter sun: all of the light, none of the heat. Nice try, sun.

rulings.imageConcept: A washing line in a beautiful Boland garden on a cold bright day: plain unbranded jerseys, blankets and school socks pegged out in stiff winter sun, snow-tipped Boland peaks sharp behind a hedge of winter roses. A dachshund in a little knitted jersey supervises from a sunny patch of lawn, centre-right. Composition: peaks low on the frame, crisp blue sky open across the top third; line and dog centre-right.

lines.af: Die son gaan weg en vat al die grade saam.
lines.en: The sun is leaving and taking all the degrees with it.

lines.af: Jy kan die koue sien inkom. Dit maak nie eers geheim daarvan nie.
lines.en: You can watch the cold arriving. It's not even being subtle about it.

lines.af: Houtrook teen skemer: die Highveld se winterparfuum.
lines.en: Woodsmoke at dusk: the Highveld's winter perfume.

rulings.imageConcept: Highveld winter dusk: the sky burning tangerine-to-violet over silhouetted bluegum trees, woodsmoke from unseen homes hanging in flat blue layers above gold grassland. A dirt road with a farm gate catches the last warm light, gate centre-right. Air visibly crystalline. Composition: the immense colour-graded sky fills the wide-open top third and more; gate and treeline sit low, centre-right.

lines.af: Selfs die kat het besluit buite is 'n fout.
lines.en: Even the cat has decided outside was a mistake.

lines.af: Die bakkie gaan môreoggend twee keer hoes voor hy vat. Boek dit.
lines.en: The bakkie is going to cough twice before it starts tomorrow. Book it.

lines.af: Gordyne toe, kaggel aan, wêreld af.
lines.en: Curtains closed, fire on, world off.

rulings.imageConcept: A thatched Karoo cottage at dusk, windows glowing amber, the last plum-coloured light on the horizon behind a windmill silhouette. Frost already forming a sparkle on the parked bakkie's roof. A cat sits pointedly at the front door waiting to be let in, centre-right. Composition: deep gradient sky wide open across the top third; cottage, bakkie and cat grouped centre-right.

rulings.comment: Die Atlantiese Oseaan is altyd so koud. Vanaand het die lug net besluit om saam te speel.

lines.af: Die Atlantiese Oseaan is altyd hierdie koud. Vanaand het die lug net besluit om saam te speel.
lines.en: The Atlantic is always this cold. Tonight the air just decided to match it.

lines.af: Draffers in langbroeke: die amptelike teken dat winter ernstig is.
lines.en: Joggers in long pants: the official sign that winter means business.

lines.af: Die hond is in sy element. Die mens is in vier lae.
lines.en: The dog is in his element. The human is in four layers.

rulings.imageConcept: Sea Point promenade at cold winter dusk: wet paving reflecting a molten pink-and-slate sunset over a heaving Atlantic, streetlamps just flicking on. Two joggers in beanies and gloves head home mid-right, and a man walks a big fluffy dog that clearly wanted this weather. Composition: vast burning sky over the ocean holds the open top third; promenade figures and lamps anchor centre-right.

lines.af: Sop-seisoen is amptelik oop. Alle ander etes is opgeskort.
lines.en: Soup season is officially open. All other meals are suspended.

lines.af: Die huis met die potjie op die stoof wen vanaand die buurt.
lines.en: The house with the pot on the stove wins the neighbourhood tonight.

lines.af: Binne daardie prentjie is dit ook koud. Hulle staan net naby die stoof vir oorlewing.
lines.en: It's cold inside that picture too. They're just standing near the stove for survival.

rulings.imageConcept: A Midlands stone farmhouse kitchen seen from the frosty garden at dusk: warm golden window framing a family of three moving around a steaming pot, bare oak branches overhead, the last cobalt light on snow-dusted hills behind the roofline. Composition: dusky blue sky and hilltops keep the top third open; the lit window and family sit centre-right, frost glinting in the foreground lawn.

rulings.comment: Laaste een by die huis sit die kaggel aan. Ry, vriend, ry.

lines.af: Iemand ry nou huis toe met die verwarmer op vol en die sitplekverwarmer as bonus.
lines.en: Somebody's driving home right now with the heater on full and the seat warmer as a bonus.

lines.af: Die pas is mooi. Die pas is ook -2°C se voorprogram.
lines.en: The pass is beautiful. The pass is also the opening act for -2°C.

lines.af: Laaste een by die huis maak die kaggel aan. Ry, vriend, ry.
lines.en: Last one home lights the fire. Drive, friend, drive.

rulings.imageConcept: Winter dusk over the Swartberg pass road: switchbacks catching the final honey light, deep purple shadow filling the valley, a lone pair of headlights descending mid-right. High cirrus glowing pink. The kind of cold, clear evening that promises hard frost. Composition: glowing sky and ridgeline own the open top third; the road and headlights curve up from bottom centre to centre-right.

lines.af: Kombers om die skouers op die stoep: nasionale drag van die winter.
lines.en: Blanket around the shoulders on the stoep: national dress of winter.

lines.af: Ons kuier buite in die koue want binne is dit, eerlikwaar, kouer.
lines.en: We're visiting outside in the cold because inside is, honestly, colder.

lines.af: Een konka, drie bure, geen haas nie.
lines.en: One brazier, three neighbours, zero hurry.

rulings.imageConcept: A Victorian veranda at dusk in a small Karoo town: broekie-lace ironwork silhouetted against a peach afterglow, fairy-soft light from the front door, three neighbours on the step wrapped in plain blankets holding mugs, mid-right, one laughing. A brazier glows at their feet. Composition: afterglow sky wide open in the top third; veranda, brazier and neighbours grouped centre-right.

lines.af: Sneeu op die Twaalf Apostels. Kaapstad gaan vir 'n week hieroor praat.
lines.en: Snow on the Twelve Apostles. Cape Town will talk about this for a week.

lines.af: Die koue front het darem 'n mooi kwitansie gelos.
lines.en: At least the cold front left a beautiful receipt.

lines.af: Kyk vinnig. Teen môre is dit weg en niemand gaan jou glo nie.
lines.en: Look quickly. By tomorrow it's gone and nobody will believe you.

rulings.imageConcept: Camps Bay side of the Twelve Apostles at winter dusk after a cold front: mountains dusted with rare snow catching alpenglow, wild pewter sea below, wet boulders shining in the foreground. Spray hangs in the cold air. No people; pure spectacle. Composition: pink-lit snowy peaks and clearing storm sky dominate the open top third; the brightest peak sits centre-right above the dark sea.

lines.af: Hout indra is die winter se gym-sessie.
lines.en: Carrying in firewood is winter's gym session.

lines.af: Die hond dra een stokkie en is trotser as al die mense saam.
lines.en: The dog carries one twig and is prouder than all the humans combined.

lines.af: Vanaand se agenda: vuur, kos, kombers, klaar.
lines.en: Tonight's agenda: fire, food, blanket, done.

rulings.imageConcept: A modern white-plaster and timber home at dusk in the Midlands: big warm-lit windows, a father and two kids carrying firewood in from a neat woodpile, breath fogging, the last lilac light on rolling frost-hazed hills behind. A collie carries one small stick, contributing. Composition: fading sky and hills open across the top third; woodpile, family and dog arranged centre-right.

lines.af: Die berg gloei soos 'n kaggel. Ongelukkig werk dit net vir die oë.
lines.en: The mountain glows like a fireplace. Unfortunately it only warms the eyes.

lines.af: Die blesbokke dra nie serpe nie en kla ook nie. Ons kan iets leer. Ons gaan nie, maar ons kan.
lines.en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.

lines.af: Vrystaat-skemer: die mooiste tien minute van die koudste aand.
lines.en: Free State dusk: the most beautiful ten minutes of the coldest night.

rulings.imageConcept: Golden Gate Highlands at winter dusk: the Brandwag sandstone buttress glowing ember-red in last light, frost-gold grassland running to its base, a small herd of blesbok grazing mid-right, breath steam visible. Sky shifting apricot to deep teal. Composition: the buttress rises from the right, its summit staying below the open top third of graded sky; blesbok centre-right on the frost line.

lines.af: Die sterre is helderder as dit koud is. Die heelal se manier van jammer sê.
lines.en: The stars shine brighter when it's cold. The universe's way of apologising.

lines.af: Vyf minute sterre kyk. Dan hardloop jy terug binnetoe. Dis die deal.
lines.en: Five minutes of stargazing. Then you run back inside. That's the deal.

lines.af: Iewers onder daardie sterre trippel iemand kaalvoet badkamer toe. Sterkte.
lines.en: Somewhere under those stars, someone is tiptoeing barefoot to the bathroom. Strength.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo night: the Milky Way in full unreal splendour over a darkened farmstead, one amber window and a windmill silhouette below. Frost glitters faintly on the fence posts in starlight. Absolute stillness. Composition: the galactic core blazes through the wide-open top third and beyond; farmstead and windmill sit small, centre-right, along the low horizon.

lines.af: Die stoel is gevat. Die hond het eerste gekom. Die reëls is die reëls.
lines.en: The chair is taken. The dog got there first. Rules are rules.

lines.af: Buite: 2 grade. Binne: 9 grade en 'n baie goeie vuur. SA huise, nè.
lines.en: Outside: 2 degrees. Inside: 9 degrees and a very good fire. SA homes, hey.

lines.af: Die laaste blok hout is 'n besluit, nie 'n voorraaditem nie.
lines.en: The last log is a decision, not an inventory item.

rulings.imageConcept: Interior night scene: a deep armchair by a stone fireplace in a thatched cottage, firelight dancing on white walls and dark beams, a plain knitted blanket draped and a steaming mug on the armrest, a sleeping jack russell curled in the seat as if he owns it. Composition: high thatch-and-beam shadows keep the top third open and dark; chair, fire and dog glow centre-right.

lines.af: Die reën klink lekker op die dak. Solank jy nié in dit is nie.
lines.en: Rain sounds lovely on the roof. Provided you are not in it.

lines.af: Kaapse winternag: die berg is daar, jy sal hom môre weer sien.
lines.en: Cape winter night: the mountain's still there, you'll see it again tomorrow.

lines.af: Elektriese kombers weer vergeet om vooraf aan te sit. Elke. Enkele. Aand.
lines.en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.

rulings.imageConcept: A Cape Dutch homestead on a cold rainy winter night: white gable floodlit softly, rain streaking through the light, warm windows reflected in puddles on the werf, mountain darkness behind. An oak drips in the foreground right. Cosy-from-a-distance mood. Composition: dark rain-hazed sky holds the open top third; gable and glowing windows sit centre-right, puddle reflections leading in from the bottom.

rulings.comment: Ouma het gesê trek 'n trui aan. Ouma was, soos altyd, reg.

lines.af: Komberse aan tafel. Ons is verby skaamte, ons is by oorlewing.
lines.en: Blankets at the dinner table. We are past shame, we are into survival.

lines.af: Die stoof maak die kos warm én die kombuis. Dubbelverdiener.
lines.en: The stove heats the food and the kitchen. Double income.

lines.af: Ouma het gesê trek 'n trui aan. Ouma het, soos altyd, reg gehad.
lines.en: Gran said put on a jersey. Gran was, as always, right.

rulings.imageConcept: A family dinner table at night in a stone farmhouse kitchen: three generations eating stew, and every single person — including the grandmother and the teenager — wrapped in a plain blanket over their shoulders, lamplight golden, windows black with cold. A pot steams on the wood stove behind them, right. Composition: dark beamed ceiling keeps the top third open; the blanketed table scene sits centre-right.

rulings.comment: Een vriend het binne gebly. Ons noem hom die verstandige een. Stilletjies.

lines.af: Koue stop nie 'n braai nie. Dit skuif net die mense nader aan die vuur.
lines.en: Cold doesn't stop a braai. It just moves the people closer to the fire.

lines.af: Een vriend het binne gebly. Ons noem hom die verstandige een. Sag.
lines.en: One friend stayed inside. We call him the sensible one. Quietly.

lines.af: Winterbraai-reël: die tang word gedeel, die hitte word nie.
lines.en: Winter braai rule: the tongs get shared, the heat does not.

rulings.imageConcept: Winter night braai defiance: two friends in beanies and thick jackets standing guard over a glowing braai in a beautiful garden, breath and smoke mingling under a string of warm festoon bulbs, frost sparkling on the lawn edges beyond the fire's reach. A third friend watches through the window from inside, mug in hand. Composition: black starry sky open across the top third; braai and friends glow centre-right.

lines.af: Die Berg dra sneeu vanaand. Iewers is 'n boer se hond klaar in die huis.
lines.en: The Berg is wearing snow tonight. Somewhere a farmer's dog has already moved indoors.

lines.af: Daardie een liggie is iemand wat winter reg doen: hut, vuur, klaar.
lines.en: That one little light is someone doing winter correctly: hut, fire, done.

lines.af: Mooi genoeg om vir 'n foto uit die kombers uit te klim. Amper.
lines.en: Beautiful enough to climb out of the blanket for a photo. Almost.

rulings.imageConcept: Full moon over snow-capped Drakensberg peaks at night: the amphitheatre wall silver-blue and monumental, moonlit frost-grass in the valley, a stone mountain hut with one lit window tiny at its base, centre-right. Stars sharp around the moon glow. Composition: peaks kept to the middle band so the moonlit sky owns the open top third; hut window is the single warm note, centre-right.

lines.af: Die dorp het sewe-uur al besluit dis kombers-tyd. Die dorp is reg.
lines.en: The town decided at seven that it's blanket time. The town is correct.

lines.af: Nat en koud is die Kaap se winterresep. Twee bestanddele, elke keer.
lines.en: Wet and cold is the Cape's winter recipe. Two ingredients, every time.

lines.af: Laaste een wat toemaak, los asseblief die liggie aan. Dit lyk mooi.
lines.en: Last one closing up, please leave the light on. It looks lovely.

rulings.imageConcept: A small country town street at night in the Overberg: wet tar shining under warm streetlights after evening rain, Victorian shopfront verandas dark and lovely, one café window glowing where a waiter stacks chairs, mid-right. Mist drifting through the lamplight. Empty, peaceful, cold. Composition: dark misty sky holds the open top third; the lit café and lamp reflections anchor centre-right down the street line.

lines.af: Een kombers, twee mense, een hond. Volmaakte verhouding.
lines.en: One blanket, two humans, one dog. The perfect ratio.

lines.af: Die afstandbeheer is aan die ander kant van die kamer. Dis nou vir ewig daar.
lines.en: The remote is on the other side of the room. It lives there now.

lines.af: Ryp teen die ruite beteken net een ding: niemand gaan êrens heen nie.
lines.en: Frost on the windows means one thing only: nobody is going anywhere.

rulings.imageConcept: A modern white-plaster and timber home at night from the garden: one huge window a rectangle of golden light, inside a mother and daughter on the sofa under one enormous plain blanket watching something off-screen, dog wedged between them. Outside, frost crystals forming on the window's lower corners and a sky thick with stars. Composition: starfield open across the top third; the lit window scene sits centre-right in darkness.

lines.af: Die son is op, maar hy werk nog nie.
lines.en: The sun has arrived. It has not yet started working.

lines.af: Mooiste leuen wat jy vandag gaan sien.
lines.en: The prettiest lie you'll see all day.

lines.af: Die gras het ryp gevang. Jy is volgende.
lines.en: The lawn caught frost overnight. You're next.

rulings.imageConcept: Highveld modern farmhouse at first light: deep charcoal cladding and warm timber, a wide lawn completely white with frost catching low golden sun. A woman in a puffer jacket and beanie stands centre-right on the frosted grass, both hands around an enamel mug, breath visible in the light. Long blue shadows stretch left. Top third is open pale-gold sky fading to clean winter blue. Portrait 9:16, aspirational and crisp.

rulings.comment: Die Karoo het die yskas oopgelos.

lines.af: Nul wind, nul wolke, nul genade.
lines.en: Zero wind. Zero clouds. Zero mercy.

lines.af: Die Karoo het die verkoeler oopgelos.
lines.en: Somebody left the freezer door open overnight.

lines.af: Pragtig, nè? Moenie hom vertrou nie.
lines.en: Gorgeous, right? Do not trust it.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo sunrise: a classic steel windpump stands centre-right against a flawless pastel sky, pink at the horizon grading up to clean blue. Frost dusts the low scrub and a farm fence line running toward the camera. Golden light rakes across red earth; the air reads glassy and still. Top third is open gradient sky. Portrait 9:16, wide serene landscape, no people, everything sharp and cold-bright.

lines.af: Joburg lyk soos 'n advertensie en voel soos 'n yskas.
lines.en: Looks like a tourism ad. Feels like the inside of a fridge.

lines.af: Daai eerste asemteug gaan jou wakker maak. Belowe.
lines.en: That first breath of air will wake you better than coffee.

lines.af: Sonskyn: 10/10. Gevoel: vra liewer nie.
lines.en: Sunshine: 10/10. Feels-like: don't ask.

rulings.imageConcept: Johannesburg skyline at dawn from a leafy ridge: glass towers catching the first gold light under a cloudless deep-blue sky. Centre-right in the mid-ground, a runner in a beanie, gloves and thermal top pauses on a paved viewpoint, breath forming a small cloud lit by the sun. Bare winter trees frame the lower left. Top third is clean open sky. Portrait 9:16, crisp city-morning energy.

rulings.comment: Die front is weg. Die koue het net ingetrek, nie geloop nie

lines.af: Die front is weg. Die koue het net getrek, nie geloop nie.
lines.en: The front left. The cold just moved in permanently.

lines.af: Sneeu op die berge beteken sokkies in die bed.
lines.en: Snow on the mountains means socks in bed. That's the law.

lines.af: Vandag se lug is skoongewas en yskoud gestryk.
lines.en: Today's sky: freshly washed, ice-pressed.

rulings.imageConcept: Cape winelands after a cold front: neat bare vineyard rows converging toward a white Cape Dutch gable centre-right, snow gleaming on the Boland peaks behind it. Low sun turns everything amber and razor-sharp; the sky is washed clean, cloudless. A thin mist of breath-like haze sits in the valley floor. Top third open blue sky above the snowy ridge. Portrait 9:16, post-front sparkle.

rulings.comment: Ryp op die draad, son in die oë, gevoel in vingers, nul.

lines.af: Die hond se asem wys ook. Dis hoe koud dit is.
lines.en: Even the dog's breath is showing. That's the reading.

lines.af: Ryp op die draad, son in die oë, gevoel in nul vingers.
lines.en: Frost on the fence, sun in your eyes, feeling in zero fingers.

rulings.imageConcept: Eastern Free State foothills at sunrise: a frosted farm fence runs from lower left toward a sandstone ridge glowing orange centre-right. A farmer in a thick fleece and wool cap walks the fence line with a border collie, both backlit, breath and dog-breath visible. Golden grass tufts are white-tipped with frost. Cloudless sky, top third open and glowing. Portrait 9:16, honest working-morning beauty.

lines.af: As die rook reguit op staan, bly jy reguit in die bed lê.
lines.en: When the chimney smoke goes straight up, you stay straight in bed.

lines.af: Windstil is net 'n mooi woord vir vrieskas.
lines.en: 'Perfectly still' is just a polite word for freezer.

lines.af: Iewers binne is dit lekker. Buite is net vir kyk.
lines.en: Somewhere inside, it's cosy. Outside is display only.

rulings.imageConcept: A thatched stone cottage centre-right at dawn, chimney smoke rising perfectly straight into a windless pink-to-blue gradient sky. Frost silvers the garden and a low stone wall in the foreground; warm lamplight glows in one window. Bare poplar silhouettes stand far left. The vertical smoke column is the tell: dead still, bitterly cold, flawlessly clear. Top third open sky. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Die lug is oop, die pad is oop, jou neus loop.
lines.en: Clear skies, open roads, running nose. The full winter set.

lines.af: Sewe-uur se son deel nog nie hitte uit nie, net vibes.
lines.en: The 7am sun isn't giving heat yet. Only vibes.

rulings.imageConcept: Pretoria avenue at dawn: bare jacaranda branches arch over a wide, empty street washed in low gold light, long shadows striping the tar. Centre-right, a cyclist in a windbreaker, buff pulled over his chin, coasts through a sunbeam, breath trailing. The sky above the branch canopy is cloudless deep blue. Top third open sky between branch tips. Portrait 9:16, crisp and cinematic.

lines.af: Die son skyn soos somer. Die lug het nie die memo gekry nie.
lines.en: The sun is doing summer. The air didn't get the memo.

lines.af: Volle sonskyn, volle baadjie. Altwee is nodig.
lines.en: Full sunshine, full jacket. Both are non-negotiable.

lines.af: Dis 'n mooi dag om binne te wees.
lines.en: It's a beautiful day to stay indoors.

rulings.imageConcept: Sandton at midday: gleaming glass-and-steel towers under a hard, flawless blue sky, winter sun bouncing off the facades. Centre-right on a smart paved plaza, two colleagues — one in a wool coat, one in a padded jacket and scarf — laugh over takeaway coffees in full sunlight. Sharp short shadows; not a single cloud. Top third is pure open blue between the towers. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Die see blink soos vakansie. Die wind chill sê andersins.
lines.en: The sea is sparkling like holidays. The air says otherwise.

lines.af: Kaapstad ná 'n front: skoon, helder, en yskoud eerlik.
lines.en: Cape Town after a front: clean, bright, and honestly freezing.

lines.af: Sonbril én serp. Dis daai soort dag.
lines.en: Sunglasses and a scarf. It's that kind of day.

rulings.imageConcept: Sea Point promenade after a front: the Atlantic glassy and glittering under brilliant midday sun, Lion's Head sharp against a rinsed-clean blue sky. Centre-right, three friends walk the promenade in puffers and beanies, one gesturing at the view mid-story. Palm fronds hang perfectly still. The light is dazzling, the sea reads ice-blue. Top third open cloudless sky. Portrait 9:16, post-front sparkle.

lines.af: Perfekte rugbyweer. Vir die toeskouers met komberse.
lines.en: Perfect rugby weather. For the spectators with blankets.

lines.af: Daai skadu-kant van die veld is 'n ander klimaatsone.
lines.en: The shady side of the field is a separate climate zone.

lines.af: Sonnig met 'n honderd persent kans van bibber.
lines.en: Sunny, with a 100% chance of shivering.

rulings.imageConcept: A pristine school rugby field on the Highveld at mid-morning: dead-flat golden winter grass, fresh white lines, tall poles centre-right throwing long crisp shadows under a saturated blue sky. Frost still clings in the shaded strip along the far stand's edge. Empty, silent, waiting. The light is glorious and hard. Top third fully open blue. Portrait 9:16, nostalgic winter-sport morning.

lines.af: Driehonderd jaar oud en steeds beter geklee vir die koue as jy.
lines.en: Three hundred years old and still better dressed for this cold than you.

lines.af: Die berge het sneeu aangetrek. Trek jy ook maar alles aan.
lines.en: The mountains put on snow. You should put on everything.

rulings.imageConcept: Stellenbosch grandeur: a whitewashed Cape Dutch manor gable glowing centre-right in hard winter sunlight, framed by ancient bare oaks, with snow-dusted Simonsberg rising behind under an immaculate blue sky. A gravel path leads in from lower left. Every edge is knife-sharp in the cold air. Top third open sky above the snowy peak. Portrait 9:16, heritage postcard with teeth.

lines.af: Die aalwyne blom, want hulle is die enigstes wat die koue geniet.
lines.en: The aloes are blooming because they're the only ones enjoying this.

lines.af: Oranje blomme, blou lug, blou lippe.
lines.en: Orange flowers, blue sky, blue lips.

lines.af: Winter in Mzansi doen kleur soos niemand anders nie.
lines.en: Mzansi winter does colour like nobody else. Warmth, though...

rulings.imageConcept: Winter aloes in full flame: a hillside garden of blazing orange aloe spikes centre-right under a deep-blue cloudless sky, Magaliesberg ridge soft in the background. A woman in a chunky knit jersey and sunhat crouches to admire one bloom, sunlight full on her face. The scene screams warmth in colour while everything else reads crisp. Top third open blue sky. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: In die son: draaglik. Twee treë links: Antarktika.
lines.en: In the sun: bearable. Two steps left: Antarctica.

lines.af: Padstalkoffie werk vandag as sentrale verhitting.
lines.en: Padstal coffee is functioning as central heating today.

lines.af: Die Karoo lieg nie oor die weer nie. Hy spog daarmee.
lines.en: The Karoo doesn't lie about the weather. It brags about it.

rulings.imageConcept: A beautifully restored Karoo padstal stoep at midday: whitewashed walls, red polished cement floor, a rusted-charm vintage bakkie parked far right. Two friends in fleece jackets sit centre-right at a small table in the direct sun, hands wrapped around steaming mugs, laughing. Beyond the railing, endless flat veld under a merciless clear sky. Top third open blue. Portrait 9:16, road-trip warmth in cold light.

lines.af: Die uitsig is gratis. Die gevoel in jou ore ook weg.
lines.en: The view is free. So is the feeling in your ears — gone.

lines.af: Hoe blouer die lug, hoe kouer die waarheid.
lines.en: The bluer the sky, the colder the truth.

rulings.imageConcept: Golden Gate Highlands: the great sandstone buttress glowing amber centre-right under a vivid, cloudless winter sky, golden grassland sweeping up to it. Two hikers in bright down jackets and beanies follow a path in the mid-ground, small against the cliff, sun full on them. The air reads thin, brilliant, biting. Top third wide open blue above the cliff line. Portrait 9:16, epic and crisp.

lines.af: Een kombers, twee mense, geen skaamte nie.
lines.en: One blanket, two people, zero shame.

lines.af: Die eende lyk gemaklik. Die eende het vere.
lines.en: The ducks look comfortable. The ducks have feathers.

lines.af: Picnic-weer volgens die oë. Sop-weer volgens die res.
lines.en: Picnic weather according to your eyes. Soup weather according to everything else.

rulings.imageConcept: Zoo Lake vibes, winter edition: a glassy lake reflecting bare willows and a flawless blue sky, geese cutting slow V-ripples. Centre-right on the sunlit bank, two siblings share a bench and one blanket over both laps, takeaway cups in hand, mid-laugh. Golden dry grass in the foreground, long clean shadows. Top third open sky over the treeline. Portrait 9:16, warm friendship in cold light.

lines.af: Nie 'n wolk in sig nie. Ook nie 'n graad nie.
lines.en: Not a cloud in sight. Not a degree either.

lines.af: Die Vrystaat se lug is vandag te groot vir sy termometer.
lines.en: The Free State sky is too big for its thermometer today.

rulings.imageConcept: Free State farm road at noon: a dead-straight gravel road running from lower left to a vanishing point centre-right, flanked by golden harvested mealie stubble stretching to the horizon. The sky is an enormous, unbroken winter blue — almost the whole frame. A single windmill and steel shed gleam tiny in the distance. Everything is sun-drenched, dry, and cold-bright. Top third pure open sky. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Die water is so helder jy kan die koue sien.
lines.en: The water is so clear you can basically see the cold.

lines.af: Sneeu op daai berge, ys in hierdie briesie.
lines.en: Snow on those mountains, ice in this breeze. Connected? Very.

lines.af: Mooiste dag van die winter. Voel soos die koudste een.
lines.en: Prettiest day of winter. Feels like the coldest one.

rulings.imageConcept: Kalk Bay harbour post-front: colourful fishing boats bobbing on glittering, glass-clear water, the harbour wall running centre-right toward a lighthouse. Behind, the Hottentots-Holland mountains wear fresh snow under a scrubbed blue sky. A fisherman in a thick jersey coils rope on the quay in brilliant sun. Everything is saturated and sharp. Top third open sky above the snowy range. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Vensterson is die enigste son wat vandag werk.
lines.en: Window sun is the only sun doing its job today.

lines.af: Dié tafel is nie te koop nie. Ons bly tot September.
lines.en: This table is not available. We live here until September now.

lines.af: Buite lyk dit heerlik. Ons het besluit om dit te glo van hier af.
lines.en: It looks lovely out there. We've chosen to believe it from in here.

rulings.imageConcept: Inside a stylish glass-fronted coffee shop: winter sun pours through floor-to-ceiling windows onto a timber counter. Centre-right, two friends in scarves sit at the window bar, flat whites steaming, both squinting happily into the light. Outside the glass, a bare tree and a hard blue sky. The sunbeam across the table is the star of the frame. Top third open sky through the glass. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Selfs die perde stoom vanoggend.
lines.en: Even the horses are steaming this morning.

lines.af: Die Midlands doen winter soos 'n skildery. 'n Baie koue skildery.
lines.en: The Midlands does winter like a painting. A very cold painting.

rulings.imageConcept: KZN Midlands farm scene: a gracious stone-and-timber farmhouse centre-right behind an avenue of bare oaks, paddocks of frosted-gold grass in front, two horses grazing with faint steam off their backs in the mid-morning sun. The sky is polished blue with the light sitting low and sharp. A wooden gate anchors the foreground. Top third open sky above the oak crowns. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Perfekte wasgoedweer. Die wasgoed gaan droog word én bevries.
lines.en: Perfect drying weather. The washing will dry and freeze, in that order.

lines.af: Die son doen sy admin buite. Hitte is nie deel van die pakket nie.
lines.en: The sun is doing admin out here. Heat was not part of the package.

lines.af: Lakens gaan vandag in kartonvorm afgehaal word.
lines.en: Those sheets are coming off the line in cardboard form.

rulings.imageConcept: A washing line moment made beautiful: crisp white linen hanging perfectly still on a line centre-right, backlit by hard midday sun against a saturated blue sky, in the manicured garden of a modern Highveld home with a low stone wall. A man in a fleece pegs the last sheet, squinting into the brightness. Shadows are knife-sharp on clipped kikuyu. Top third open blue sky. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Die son gaan nou huis toe. Vat sy laaste drie grade saam.
lines.en: The sun is heading home now, taking the last three degrees with it.

lines.af: Mooiste tyd van die dag. Kortste ook. Hardloop.
lines.en: Prettiest moment of the day. Also the shortest. Run.

rulings.imageConcept: Highveld winter sunset over a farm dam: the sky burns clean orange through rose to deep blue overhead — no clouds, just gradient. Bare bluegum silhouettes stand centre-right, doubled perfectly in the glassy dam. The temperature drop is almost visible in the still air. A jetty edge enters lower right. Top third open deepening-blue sky. Portrait 9:16, serene and sharply cold.

lines.af: Die sonsondergang is verniet. Die verkoue ook.
lines.en: The sunset is free of charge. So is the head cold.

lines.af: Golden hour, yskoue lug. Kaapstad hou van drama.
lines.en: Golden hour, ice-cold air. Cape Town loves a dramatic contrast.

lines.af: Kyk mooi. Oor tien minute is dit nag én Noordpool.
lines.en: Look quickly. In ten minutes it's night and the North Pole.

rulings.imageConcept: Sea Point promenade at golden hour after a front: the sun dropping into a flat, glittering Atlantic, sky graded tangerine to violet with zero cloud. Centre-right, two joggers in thermal layers and gloves run toward the camera along the railing, faces lit warm orange, breath faintly visible. Lion's Head is a crisp silhouette left of centre. Top third open violet sky. Portrait 9:16.

rulings.comment: Die vuur is nie vir geselligheid nie. Die vuur is vir oorlewing.

lines.af: Die vuur is nie vir gesellig nie. Die vuur is vir oorlewing.
lines.en: The fire isn't for atmosphere. The fire is for survival.

lines.af: Sit nader. Nee, nader. Ja, amper ín die vuur.
lines.en: Sit closer. No, closer. Yes, basically in the fire.

lines.af: Skoon lug vanaand. Dit beteken die koue het vrye toegang.
lines.en: Clear sky tonight. That means the cold has an all-access pass.

rulings.imageConcept: A lodge boma at blue hour: a stone fire pit centre-right just catching flame, sparks lifting into a cloudless sky still banded amber at the horizon and deep blue above. Three friends in down jackets and beanies drag chairs closer, one holding a blanket, faces warm in the firelight. Thatch roofline and bare tree silhouettes frame the far left. Top third open twilight sky. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Eerste ster is uit. Eerste tien grade is ook uit.
lines.en: First star is out. First ten degrees have also left.

lines.af: Die Karoo maak nou die dak oop. Trek warm aan vir die vertoning.
lines.en: The Karoo is opening its roof for the night. Dress warm for the show.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo dusk in bands: horizon glowing peach, then rose, then a wide indigo dome where the first bright star already burns. A windpump and water tank stand in perfect silhouette centre-right on the darkening plain. Scrub detail fades into blue shadow in the foreground; the stillness is total. Top third open indigo sky with that single star. Portrait 9:16, vast and quiet.

lines.af: Joburg se sonsondergange is winter se troosprys.
lines.en: Joburg sunsets are winter's consolation prize. It's a good prize.

lines.af: Geniet die kleure. Die temperatuur is klaar in die kar.
lines.en: Enjoy the colours. The temperature has already gone to the car.

rulings.imageConcept: Johannesburg from Northcliff ridge at last light: the city grid stretching to the horizon under a cloudless sky burning orange-to-plum, towers catching the final gold. Centre-right on a rocky outcrop, a woman in a long coat and scarf holds a thermos cup, hair still in the windless air, silhouetted rim-lit. Aloe silhouettes anchor the lower right. Top third open plum sky. Portrait 9:16.

rulings.comment: Die heelal pronk vanaand. Kyk vinnig, vries stadig.

lines.af: Hoe helderder die sterre, hoe harder werk die kombers.
lines.en: The brighter the stars, the harder your blanket has to work.

lines.af: Gratis planetarium vanaand. Toegangsprys: jou tone.
lines.en: Free planetarium tonight. Admission: your toes.

lines.af: Die heelal wys af vanaand. Kyk vinnig, vries stadig.
lines.en: The universe is showing off tonight. Look fast, freeze slowly.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo star spectacle: the Milky Way arching huge and dense across a moonless black sky over a lone stone cottage centre-right, one window glowing warm amber. The plain is a faint blue-grey wash; a windpump silhouette stands far right. The clarity of the stars is the whole point — this only happens when the air is freezing and bone-dry. Top third packed with open starfield. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Vyf minute se sterrekyk. Dan terug binnetoe vir ewig.
lines.en: Five minutes of stargazing. Then back inside forever.

lines.af: Die ryp is klaar besig. Teen dagbreek is die grasperk 'n spieël.
lines.en: The frost has already started its shift. By dawn the lawn will be glass.

lines.af: Rooibos in die hande, kombers tot by die ore. Volkome uitrusting.
lines.en: Rooibos in hand, blanket to the ears. Full kit.

rulings.imageConcept: Highveld stoep at night: a modern farmhouse patio with a single warm wall light, a man cocooned in a thick blanket on a wooden chair centre-right, steaming rooibos mug in both hands, looking up at a crisp star-strewn sky. Frost is already forming a faint sparkle on the lawn beyond the stoep edge. Deep blue night, sharp stars, dead still. Top third open starry sky. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: So helder sien jy Kaapstad net wanneer dit regtig seer is buite.
lines.en: The city only looks this sharp when it genuinely hurts outside.

lines.af: Geen wind, geen wolke, geen verskoning om nie warm aan te trek nie.
lines.en: No wind, no clouds, no excuse for that thin jacket.

rulings.imageConcept: Cape Town city bowl from Signal Hill on a rare wind-still, crystal-clear winter night: the city lights spread in razor-sharp detail toward the black harbour, Table Mountain's dark mass rising right of centre. Above, a clean field of stars — no haze, no cloud. A low stone wall runs across the foreground. The clarity itself signals the cold. Top third open starry sky. Portrait 9:16.

rulings.comment: Binne daai huis is die beste plek in die land vanaand

lines.af: Binne daardie venster is die beste plek in die land vanaand.
lines.en: Inside that window is currently the best location in the country.

lines.af: Kaggelweer. Amptelik. Die app sê so.
lines.en: Fireplace weather. Official. The app said so.

lines.af: Die sterre is pragtig. Bewonder hulle deur die venster.
lines.en: The stars are stunning. Admire them through the window.

rulings.imageConcept: A thatched cottage at night, seen from the garden: firelight flickering gold through a paned window centre-right, chimney smoke rising dead straight into a star-thick black sky. Frost glints faintly on the lawn and a wheelbarrow by the wall. The contrast of the warm interior square against the vast cold night carries the frame. Top third open stars above the roofline. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Die maan het die berge aangeskakel. Die hitte, egter, nie.
lines.en: The moon switched the mountains on. The heat, however, stays off.

lines.af: Asem soos 'n draak, uitsig soos 'n droom.
lines.en: Breathing like a dragon, view like a dream.

rulings.imageConcept: Drakensberg lodge deck under a full moon: the great escarpment glowing pale blue in moonlight centre-right, every ridge sharp in the freezing clear air. On the timber deck, a woman wrapped in a mohair blanket leans on the railing, breath visible in the moonlight, a lantern glowing at her feet. Stars burn hard around the moon. Top third open moonlit sky. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Niemand staan by die kole vir die kos nie. Ons staan vir die hitte.
lines.en: Nobody's standing at the coals for the food. We're here for the heat.

lines.af: Winteraand-reël: die tang word gedeel, die vuurplek nie.
lines.en: Winter night rule: the tongs get shared. The spot next to the fire doesn't.

lines.af: Sterre bo, kole onder, vriende rondom. Die koue kan maar probeer.
lines.en: Stars above, coals below, friends around. The cold can try its best.

rulings.imageConcept: Late-night coals: a beautiful kettle grill glowing orange centre-right on a smart paved patio, three friends in beanies and padded jackets huddled around it on stools, faces lit from below, one turning something with tongs. Above them, an enormous clear winter sky full of stars; string lights off, only fire and starlight. Frost-sparkle on the lawn edge. Top third open starfield. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Môreoggend se eerste taak: vyf minute ys krap in jou kerkklere.
lines.en: Tomorrow's first task: five minutes of windscreen scraping in your work clothes.

lines.af: Die karre het klaar opgegee. Hulle slaap onder ys.
lines.en: The cars have surrendered. They're sleeping under ice tonight.

lines.af: Stil, helder, vriesend. Die klassieke Hoëveld-drieling.
lines.en: Still, clear, freezing. The classic Highveld triple.

rulings.imageConcept: A quiet, upmarket tree-lined street at night: warm streetlamps pooling gold light on the pavement, a row of parked cars centre-right with windscreens already crystalled in frost, glittering under the lamps. Above the dark oak canopy, a strip of hard, clear stars. No people; the frozen glass and the still air tell the story. Top third open night sky between branches. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Die wingerd slaap. Die koue werk nagskof.
lines.en: The vines are asleep. The cold is working the night shift.

lines.af: Sneeu in die maanlig — mooi op die berg, verskriklik in die lug.
lines.en: Snow in the moonlight: beautiful on the mountain, brutal in the air.

rulings.imageConcept: Stellenbosch vineyard by moonlight: bare vine rows running toward a moonlit mountain wall centre-right, its snow-dusted upper slopes gleaming faintly silver. The sky is clear and deep, stars sharp away from the moon's glow. A historic white gable catches moonlight at the row's end, far right. Frost-sheen on the vine posts. Top third open night sky above the ridge. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: Vyf-ster akkommodasie. Nee wag — vyf miljoen.
lines.en: Five-star accommodation. Wait, no — five million.

lines.af: Die plan was tien minute. Die neuse het ná twee ingegee.
lines.en: The plan was ten minutes. The noses tapped out after two.

lines.af: Helder nagte is die winter se jammer-sê.
lines.en: Clear nights are winter's way of apologising.

rulings.imageConcept: Stargazing off the back of a bakkie: a clean double-cab parked on a farm track, tailgate down, two siblings lying in the load bed centre-right under a mound of blankets and pillows, faces up, pointing at a colossal Milky Way that dominates the frame. A flask and two enamel mugs sit on the tailgate. The veld is a dark, still sea around them. Top third dense open starfield. Portrait 9:16.

lines.af: 06:00 en die son is klaar klaar met opwarm. Dit was nie 'n opwarming nie, dit was 'n waarskuwing.
lines.en: 6am and the sun is already done warming up. That wasn't a warm-up, that was a warning.

lines.af: Die dag het nog nie eers begin nie en hy wen alreeds.
lines.en: The day hasn't even started yet and it's already winning.

lines.af: Drink jou koffie gou. Teen sewe is dit sop.
lines.en: Drink your coffee fast. By seven it's soup.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo cottage at first light: deep-shade veranda with whitewashed pillars and a corrugated roof, endless flat-topped koppies glowing pink on the horizon. A middle-aged Black man in a light shirt stands centre-right at the veranda edge, enamel coffee mug in hand, looking out at a sky already hazing gold with heat. Top third pure pale-apricot dawn sky, completely open. Warm rim light, long soft shadows across red Karoo earth, aloes in the foreground right. Portrait 9:16, aspirational and still.

rulings.comment: Skooldrag met 'n langbroek was vandag 'n dare. Sterkte, my kind.

lines.af: As dit nóú al so voel, gaan tweede pouse 'n oorlewingsport wees.
lines.en: If it feels like this now, second break is going to be a survival sport.

lines.af: Skooldrag met 'n langbroek was vandag 'n gok. Sterkte, my kind.
lines.en: Long pants with the uniform was a gamble today. Strength, my child.

lines.af: 06:30 en die teer dink al aan smelt.
lines.en: 6:30 and the tar is already considering melting.

rulings.imageConcept: Modern white-plaster-and-timber family home on the Highveld at sunrise, jacaranda-lined street behind. Centre-right, a Coloured mom crouches to fix her son's school shoe at the timber front gate, his backpack catching low golden light; dew already steaming faintly off the driveway. Sprinkler mist drifts across a deep-green lawn, foreground left. Top third wide-open blue-gold morning sky. Portrait 9:16, crisp light, warm domestic energy, no visible logos or readable text.

lines.af: Stap nou of stap glad nie. Die Laeveld gee jou tot sewe-uur.
lines.en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.

lines.af: Die voëls het klaar stil geraak. Hulle weet iets.
lines.en: The birds have already gone quiet. They know something.

lines.af: Vandag se oefensessie: van die kar tot by die aircon.
lines.en: Today's workout: car to aircon.

rulings.imageConcept: Lowveld thatch lodge deck at dawn: heavy timber balustrade, thatched eaves top-left corner only, bushveld rolling away in layers of gold haze toward the Drakensberg escarpment. Centre-right, a young Black woman in gym wear stretches against the railing, water bottle at her feet, skin lit warm by the first sun. A fever tree glows yellow-green mid-frame. Top third fully open peach-to-blue gradient sky. Portrait 9:16, serene, humid golden atmosphere.

lines.af: Die bergwind het in die nag gedraai. Kaapstad, vandag is jy Upington.
lines.en: The berg wind turned overnight. Cape Town, today you're basically Upington.

lines.af: Die see is 12 grade. Teen tienuur gaan dit soos 'n spa voel.
lines.en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.

lines.af: Vandag swem selfs die mense wat 'net kom kyk het'.
lines.en: Today even the people who 'just came to watch' are swimming.

rulings.imageConcept: Glass-and-steel Atlantic seaboard apartment balcony at sunrise, Lion's Head silhouette soft in golden haze to the right. Centre-right, an Indian man in a towel-draped swim robe leans on the frameless glass balustrade, goggles dangling from one hand, looking down at a flat, glassy pink-silver sea. Infinity edge of a building pool glints below. Top third open pastel sky with one wisp of cloud. Portrait 9:16, luxurious calm, warm berg-wind light.

lines.af: Almal wat nou draf, gaan teen middagete daaroor spog. Dis die hele punt.
lines.en: Everyone running now will be bragging about it by lunch. That's the whole point.

lines.af: Die 05:30-drawwers is nie fikser as ons nie. Hulle is net slimmer.
lines.en: The 5:30 runners aren't fitter than us. They're just smarter.

lines.af: Selfs die son het vroeg opgestaan om die verkeer te klop.
lines.en: Even the sun got up early to beat the traffic.

rulings.imageConcept: Johannesburg suburb at 5:30am: a wide tree-lined avenue with modern white-plaster walls and lush verges, purple-tinged light breaking gold between the trees. Centre-right, three friends — Black woman, white man, Coloured woman — jog toward camera in running gear, relaxed mid-laugh stride, long shadows stretching left. Haze of early heat shimmer above the road. Top third open glowing sky between treetops. Portrait 9:16, energetic, beautiful golden Joburg morning.

lines.af: Die swembad is reeds bespreek. Deur almal. Vir die hele dag.
lines.en: The pool is already fully booked. By everyone. For the whole day.

lines.af: Die eerste een in mag nie kla dis koud nie. Dis die reël.
lines.en: First one in doesn't get to complain that it's cold. That's the rule.

lines.af: Teen twaalfuur is hierdie water bad-temperatuur. Beplan daarvolgens.
lines.en: By noon this water is bath temperature. Plan accordingly.

rulings.imageConcept: Modern white-plaster-and-timber home's pool at dawn: mirror-still turquoise water reflecting an apricot sky, timber deck edging the frame bottom-right, a pool net leaning against a plastered wall. Centre-right, a barefoot Black teenager in swim shorts sits on the pool step, feet in the water, towel over one shoulder, first sun catching the ripples he makes. Steam wisps off the surface. Top third completely open dawn sky. Portrait 9:16, quiet anticipation, premium suburban summer.

lines.af: Selfs die hond het die voorspelling gecheck en teruggegaan bed toe.
lines.en: Even the dog checked the forecast and went straight back to bed.

lines.af: Die windpomp staan doodstil. Nie eers die wind wil vandag werk nie.
lines.en: The windpomp is dead still. Even the wind isn't coming in to work today.

lines.af: Skaduwee-jagseisoen maak amptelik om sewe-uur oop.
lines.en: Shade-hunting season officially opens at seven.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo farmyard at sunrise: a classic steel windpomp stands dead still against a blazing orange-pink sky, its blades perfectly motionless. Centre-right foreground, a golden farm dog lies flat in the cool sand under a pepper tree, one eyebrow raised at the camera. Karoo cottage with deep shade veranda soft-focus in the middle distance, red earth and scattered aloes. Top third wide-open glowing sky around the windmill's silhouette. Portrait 9:16, dry heat you can feel.

rulings.comment: a white woman and a white man, sixties, sun-hats off

lines.af: 35 in die skadu. In die son tel niemand meer nie.
lines.en: 35 in the shade. In the sun, nobody's counting anymore.

lines.af: Die plan vir vandag is die stoep. Dis die hele plan.
lines.en: Today's plan is the stoep. That's the entire plan.

lines.af: Beweeg stadig. Praat stadig. Oorleef.
lines.en: Move slowly. Speak slowly. Survive.

rulings.imageConcept: Midday on a Karoo cottage's deep-shade veranda: thick whitewashed walls, cool slate floor, a slow ceiling fan blurred mid-spin. Centre-right, two old friends — a white woman and a Black man, sixties, sun-hats off — sit low in riempie chairs with condensation-beaded glasses of iced rooibos, utterly motionless. Beyond the veranda's shadow line, the Karoo blazes white-hot and over-exposed. Top third open bleached-blue sky above the roofline. Portrait 9:16, contrast of deep cool shade against furnace light.

lines.af: Snaaks hoe almal skielik onthou hulle is lief vir jou wanneer jy 'n swembad het.
lines.en: Funny how everyone suddenly remembers they love you when you own a pool.

lines.af: Bring jou eie ys. Die vriendskap dek nie ys nie.
lines.en: Bring your own ice. The friendship doesn't cover ice.

lines.af: Swembad-toegang is die nuwe geldeenheid.
lines.en: Pool access is the new currency.

rulings.imageConcept: Sparkling pool of a modern white-plaster-and-timber home under hard midday sun. Centre-right, three friends — Black man, Coloured woman, white man, late twenties — crowd the shallow end laughing, one balancing a plain unbranded cooler box on the pool edge, drinks held above the splash. Deep-green tropical planting and a timber pergola frame the right edge; heat shimmer over the paving. Top third wide-open cobalt sky. Portrait 9:16, joyful, sun-drenched, aspirational backyard summer.

lines.af: Selfs die rooibokke staan in die skadu en heroorweeg hul keuses.
lines.en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.

lines.af: Laeveld-somer: jy sweet nie, jy smelt met waardigheid.
lines.en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.

lines.af: Die bosveld is vandag op stille modus. Almal. Alles.
lines.en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.

rulings.imageConcept: Lowveld thatch lodge plunge pool at high noon: dark rim-flow water in a timber deck, overlooking khaki bushveld shimmering with heat haze to a hazy blue escarpment. Centre-right, a young Indian woman floats on her back in the plunge pool, sunglasses on, one arm trailing, completely at peace. A lone marula tree holds a pool of dense shade mid-distance where antelope shapes cluster. Top third open white-blue burning sky. Portrait 9:16, languid safari luxury.

lines.af: Die lug sê 34. Die water sê 13. Kies jou geveg.
lines.en: The air says 34. The water says 13. Pick your fight.

lines.af: Die Atlantiese Oseaan: die enigste plek waar jy gelyktydig kan verbrand én verkluim.
lines.en: The Atlantic: the only place where you can burn and freeze at the same time.

lines.af: Dapper is die een wat verby die knieë ingaan.
lines.en: Brave is whoever goes in past the knees.

rulings.imageConcept: Clifton-style Atlantic cove at midday: giant smooth granite boulders, impossibly turquoise-to-navy water, white sand glowing. Centre-right, three friends — two Black women and a white man — stand ankle-deep at the waterline, mid-shriek-laugh at the cold, arms out for balance. A cream beach umbrella throws a disc of shade on the sand behind them. Twelve Apostles hazy in right background. Top third open deep-blue summer sky. Portrait 9:16, iconic Cape Town beach day.

lines.af: Waatlemoen is nie nagereg nie. Dis noodhulp.
lines.en: Watermelon isn't dessert. It's first aid.

lines.af: Middagete het buitetoe getrek, want binne is warmer as buite. Niemand kan dit verklaar nie.
lines.en: Lunch moved outside because inside is hotter than outside. Nobody can explain it.

lines.af: Die oudste boom het die beste sitplekke. Soos altyd.
lines.en: The oldest tree has the best seats. As always.

rulings.imageConcept: Long farm lunch table dragged into the deep shade of an ancient wild fig beside a Karoo cottage with a shaded veranda. Centre-right, a multi-generational Coloured family — gran, dad, two kids — passes glistening watermelon wedges down the table, juice catching the dappled light. White tablecloth, enamel jugs, no readable labels. Sun-blasted veld glows beyond the tree's shadow circle. Top third open through branches to blinding blue sky. Portrait 9:16, warm, generous, timeless summer lunch.

lines.af: Die dag blaas uiteindelik uit. Ons ook.
lines.en: The day is finally exhaling. So are we.

lines.af: Die eerste sluk ná 'n 35-grade dag behoort eerlikwaar belasbaar te wees.
lines.en: The first sip after a 35-degree day should honestly be taxable.

lines.af: Ons praat nie oor vandag nie. Vandag is verby. Ons is trots op ons.
lines.en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.

rulings.imageConcept: Golden hour on the timber stoep of a modern white-plaster-and-timber home: honey light raking across the deck, day's heat visibly softening. Centre-right, two neighbours — a Black man and a white man, forties, work shirts untucked — lean on the balustrade with condensation-beaded bottles, plain unbranded cooler box at their feet, both gazing out at a molten-gold garden and distant ridge. Top third open amber-to-dusty-pink sky. Portrait 9:16, relief and easy friendship, end-of-scorcher glow.

lines.af: Niemand klim uit nie. Die water het ons nou eers vergewe.
lines.en: Nobody is getting out. The water has only just forgiven us.

lines.af: Aandete kan wag. Goue uur in die swembad kan nie.
lines.en: Supper can wait. Golden hour in the pool cannot.

lines.af: 'Nog vyf minute' is nou al veertig minute lank. Laat hulle.
lines.en: 'Five more minutes' has been going for forty minutes now. Let them.

rulings.imageConcept: Backyard pool at golden hour, water turned to liquid amber glass, modern white-plaster-and-timber house glowing warm behind. Centre-right, three kids — diverse Mzansi casting — mid-cannonball-splash and hanging off the pool edge, backlit spray exploding into gold droplets. A parent silhouette relaxes on a lounger far right, towel ready and clearly ignored. Long shadows across the deck. Top third open honey-and-rose sky. Portrait 9:16, pure summer-evening joy.

lines.af: 19:00 en steeds 30 grade. Die Karoo maak nie foute nie, net stellings.
lines.en: 7pm and still 30 degrees. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.

lines.af: Die klippe gaan vannag nog die dag se hitte uitdeel. Verniet.
lines.en: The rocks will be handing out today's heat all night. Free of charge.

lines.af: Sonsondergang is die Karoo se manier van jammer sê.
lines.en: Sunset is the Karoo's way of apologising.

rulings.imageConcept: Karoo dusk in full fire: banded orange-crimson-violet sky over black flat-topped koppies, windpomp silhouette small on the left horizon. Centre-right, a Black woman in a light summer dress sits on the wide steps of a Karoo cottage's deep shade veranda, glass of chilled white wine catching the last light, face turned to the sky. Stone still radiating visible warmth in the warm-toned foreground. Top third fully open blazing gradient sky. Portrait 9:16, vast, cinematic, still hot.

lines.af: Die hele stad het vanaand dieselfde plan gehad. Kyk hoe lyk ons.
lines.en: The whole city had the same plan tonight. Look at us all.

lines.af: Roomys om agtuur is nie nagereg nie, dis 'n herstelplan.
lines.en: Ice cream at eight isn't dessert, it's a recovery plan.

lines.af: Die son sak eers ná agt. Somer weet hoe om 'n aand te rek.
lines.en: The sun only sets after eight. Summer knows how to stretch an evening.

rulings.imageConcept: Sea Point-style promenade at 8pm golden hour: palm silhouettes, glass-and-steel apartment facades glowing pink behind, Atlantic flat and molten under a huge setting sun. Centre-right, three friends — Coloured woman, Black man, Indian woman — stroll toward camera with dripping soft-serve cones, laughing, sea breeze in their clothes. Joggers and dog-walkers soft-focus along the railing. Top third open rose-gold sky over the water. Portrait 9:16, whole-city-outside summer evening energy.

lines.af: Die eerste briesie van die dag het nou net opgedaag. Gee hom applous.
lines.en: The first breeze of the day has just arrived. Give it a round of applause.

lines.af: Sundowners is nie 'n luukse in die Laeveld nie. Dis medies.
lines.en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.

lines.af: Die dag het ons probeer opeet. Ons drink nou daarop.
lines.en: The day tried to finish us. We're drinking to that now.

rulings.imageConcept: Lowveld thatch lodge viewing deck at sundowner hour: bushveld rolling away in layered gold and dusty mauve, a giant orange sun balanced on the escarpment. Centre-right, three friends — Black woman, white woman, Black man — clink tall iced drinks at the timber railing, hair and shirts just beginning to stir in an evening breeze. Lanterns unlit on the deck table, fever trees catching last light below. Top third open flaming sky. Portrait 9:16, classic safari sundowner, hard-earned relief.

lines.af: Die sproeier is kamma vir die gras. Kyk wie staan almal in die water.
lines.en: The sprinkler is supposedly for the lawn. Look who's all standing in the water.

lines.af: Grootmense wat 'net deur die tuin stap' presies waar die sproeier spuit. Toeval, nè.
lines.en: Adults 'just taking a garden stroll' exactly where the sprinkler sprays. Coincidence, nè.

lines.af: Die gras kry water. Die mense kry terapie.
lines.en: The lawn gets water. The people get therapy.

rulings.imageConcept: Lush Highveld garden of a modern white-plaster-and-timber home at dusk, sprinkler throwing wide backlit arcs of gold spray across a deep lawn. Centre-right, a Black dad and his young daughter stand deliberately inside the spray, arms out, drenched and delighted, droplets frozen like sparks in the low sun. Agapanthus in glowing foreground, timber deck edge soft-focus left. Top third open apricot dusk sky above the treeline. Portrait 9:16, playful, glowing, the day's heat breaking.

lines.af: Vyf meter sig. Nes jou vyfjaarplan.
lines.en: Five metres of visibility. Same as your five-year plan.

lines.af: Die plaas is nog daar. Ons vat maar mekaar se woord daarvoor.
lines.en: The farm is still there. We're all just taking each other's word for it.

lines.af: Die GPS sê jy het opgedaag. Die GPS jok.
lines.en: Your GPS says you have arrived. Your GPS is lying.

rulings.imageConcept: A Boland farm lane at first light: two ruler-straight rows of old gum trees dissolving into pearl-grey fog, a red-earth dirt road running centre-frame toward nothing. A distant Cape Dutch gable is only a pale suggestion far right. Soft apricot glow low in the mist, dew silvering the grass verges. No people, no signage, no vehicles. Portrait 9:16, top third pure luminous fog and pale sky, the lane and trees anchored centre-right, hushed and expectant.

lines.af: Snoekweer, sê die ooms. Die ooms is nog nooit verkeerd nie.
lines.en: Snoek weather, say the uncles. The uncles have never once been wrong.

lines.af: Die horison het vandag verlof gevat.
lines.en: The horizon took the day off.

lines.af: Die seemis het voor almal ingeklok.
lines.en: The sea mist clocked in before everyone else.
