rulings.imageConcept: Kalk Bay harbour at dawn in thick sea mist: wooden fishing boats in faded turquoise and red rafted along the quay, their hulls sharp but masts fading upward into white. A single gull perched on a plain bollard, wet cobbles glossing gold where the hidden sun tries. Two weathered fishermen of colour in oilskins, mid-laugh, stand right of frame coiling rope. No readable names on hulls, plain painted wood only. Portrait 9:16, top third open mist, boats and figures centre-right.

lines.af: Die koeie weet presies waar hulle is. Meer as wat ons kan sê.
lines.en: The cows know exactly where they are. Which is more than the rest of us can say.

lines.af: Midlands-mis: die platteland se privaatheid-instelling.
lines.en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.

lines.af: Alles onder die kombers is amptelik nie vandag se probleem nie.
lines.en: Everything under the blanket is officially not today's problem.

rulings.imageConcept: KZN Midlands dairy country at sunrise: rolling emerald pasture sliding under a low white mist blanket, weathered post-and-rail fence running in from the right, three Nguni cattle emerging chest-deep from the fog like ships, their patched hides jewelled with dew. Faint gold rim-light on the mist's surface. No buildings, no people, no signs. Portrait 9:16, top third soft pale sky and mist-glow, cattle grouped centre-right, serene and slightly comic in their calm.

lines.af: In die Karoo is mis 'n gebeurtenis. Môre praat die hele distrik hieroor.
lines.en: In the Karoo, fog is an event. The whole district will be talking about this tomorrow.

lines.af: Die stilte het vanoggend 'n kombers aangetrek.
lines.en: The silence put on a blanket this morning.

lines.af: Selfs die vlaktes hou vandag geheime.
lines.en: Even the plains are keeping secrets today.

rulings.imageConcept: A rare Karoo fog at dawn: a whitewashed thatched Karoo cottage with deep-set windows glowing warm amber, positioned right of frame, and a windpomp behind it half-dissolved into peach-and-grey mist. Frost-silvered scrub in the foreground, one plain enamel jug steaming on the stoep wall. No people, no text anywhere. Portrait 9:16, top third open misted sky blushing rose, cottage and windpomp centre-right, the whole scene hushed like a held breath.

rulings.comment: Ry asof jou ma jou dophou.

lines.af: Die see is daar onder. Waarskynlik.
lines.en: The sea is down there. Probably.

lines.af: Chappies vra vanoggend geloof, nie net 'n lisensie nie.
lines.en: Chappies is asking for faith this morning, not just a licence.

lines.af: Ry soos jou ma kyk.
lines.en: Drive like your mother is watching.

rulings.imageConcept: Chapman's Peak Drive at dawn: the famous ribbon of road curving centre-right along golden sandstone cliffs before vanishing cleanly into a wall of soft white fog, the sea below completely erased. Warm first light catching the rock face and the low stone barrier wall, one pair of faint headlight glows deep inside the mist. No cars sharp enough to show plates, no signage. Portrait 9:16, top third open pale-gold sky above the fog bank, road sweeping from lower centre to the right.

lines.af: Die buurt is weg. Koffie eers, dan kyk ons weer.
lines.en: The neighbourhood is gone. Coffee first, then we'll check again.

lines.af: Jy hoor die hadidas, maar jy sien niks. Onheilspellend? Nee. Net Dinsdag.
lines.en: You can hear the hadedas but you can't see them. Ominous? No. Just Tuesday.

lines.af: Sig: nul. Gemoed: verbasend rustig daaroor.
lines.en: Visibility: zero. Mood: surprisingly at peace with it.

rulings.imageConcept: A Victorian veranda with white broekie-lace ironwork on a leafy old suburban street, early morning: a Black South African woman in a thick gown and slippers stands centre-right at the railing, both hands around a plain unbranded enamel mug, steam rising, gazing amused into a garden that simply stops existing two metres out — pure soft fog beyond the roses. Warm hallway light spills behind her. Portrait 9:16, top third open misted whiteness, cosy and wry.

lines.af: Iewers hier is 'n uitsig. Die brosjure het belowe.
lines.en: There's a view here somewhere. The brochure promised.

lines.af: Moenie stres nie — die berge buffer nog.
lines.en: Relax, the mountains are just buffering.

lines.af: Vanoggend se spitsverkeer: een kano.
lines.en: This morning's rush hour: one canoe.

rulings.imageConcept: Wilderness lagoon at dawn: glass-still tea-coloured water merging seamlessly into low fog so lagoon and sky become one pale-gold field. A single wooden canoe with a young coloured man paddling drifts centre-right, his reflection perfect, ripples the only geometry. A dark fringe of milkwood trees ghosts along the right edge. No jetties with signage, no buildings. Portrait 9:16, top third pure luminous fog, dreamlike, quiet, a little absurd in its emptiness.

lines.af: Sig: swak. Vibes: onaantasbaar.
lines.en: Visibility: poor. Vibes: untouchable.

lines.af: Die mis het die kleure kom leen. Hy bring hulle môre terug.
lines.en: The fog is borrowing the colours. It'll return them in the morning.

lines.af: Elke venster wat aangaan is iemand wat besluit het: genoeg vir vandag.
lines.en: Every window switching on is someone deciding: that's enough for today.

rulings.imageConcept: A Bo-Kaap terrace at dusk: a short row of flat-fronted colour-washed houses — teal, coral, mustard — softened by fog drifting down the cobbled slope, their windows lighting up warm one by one. Wet cobbles reflect the glow. An older Cape Malay man in a knitted jersey waters pot plants on the far-right stoep. Streetlamp halos bloom in the mist. No signage, no cars with plates. Portrait 9:16, top third open grey-lavender fog, houses stacked centre-right descending.

lines.af: Die mis sê bly. Wie's ons om te stry?
lines.en: The fog says stay. Who are we to argue?

lines.af: Niemand ry nou nog huis toe nie. Dis nie luiheid nie, dis wetenskap.
lines.en: Nobody is driving home in this. That's not laziness, that's science.

lines.af: Kaggelweer het opgedaag sonder om eers te vra.
lines.en: Fireplace weather showed up without even asking.

rulings.imageConcept: A modern white-plaster-and-timber home on the Constantia treeline at dusk, fog pressing softly against floor-to-ceiling glass that glows honey-warm. On the wide deck, three friends — a Black woman, an Indian man, a white woman, all in beanies and blankets — laugh around a low fire bowl, faces lit orange, the garden beyond swallowed whole. Plain mugs, no labels. Portrait 9:16, top third soft slate fog fading to dark, group and glow set centre-right.

lines.af: Perfekte weer om iemand raak te loop wat jy 'nog wou bel'.
lines.en: Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.

lines.af: Die dorp het homself op fluistervolume gesit.
lines.en: The whole town just switched itself to whisper volume.

lines.af: Elke straatlig dink hy's vanaand die maan.
lines.en: Every streetlamp thinks it's the moon tonight.

rulings.imageConcept: A Stellenbosch oak lane at dusk in fog: massive oak trunks marching into whiteness, every old cast-iron streetlamp wearing a perfect glowing halo, a whitewashed Cape Dutch gable dissolving far right. Two students — one Black, one white — push bicycles side by side, mid-conversation, breath visible, positioned centre-right. Fallen oak leaves gloss the wet brick pavement. No readable signs or posters. Portrait 9:16, top third open misted canopy and lamp-glow, romantic-but-friendly small-town hush.

lines.af: Die hele straat ruik na iemand anders se kos. Die mis hou die geheim.
lines.en: The whole street smells like someone else's dinner and the fog won't say whose.

lines.af: Kom ons noem dit atmosfeer en gaan in.
lines.en: Let's call it atmosphere and go inside.

lines.af: Highveld-mis: skaars genoeg dat almal dit afneem.
lines.en: Highveld fog: rare enough that everyone's photographing it.

rulings.imageConcept: A jacaranda-lined Pretoria street at dusk in winter fog: bare sculptural jacaranda branches arching over the road, sodium streetlights turning the mist a soft amber, warm gate lamps glowing at a restored 1920s tin-roof house with a deep pillared veranda set right of frame. A silhouetted neighbour wheels a bin up a driveway, unhurried. No visible house numbers, plates or signage. Portrait 9:16, top third open amber-grey mist through branches, homely and cinematic.

lines.af: Ysswemmers check nie die weer nie. Die weer check hulle.
lines.en: Ice swimmers don't check the weather. The weather checks them.

lines.af: Sig is vir mense wat omdraai.
lines.en: Visibility is for people who turn back.

lines.af: Die see is weg maar die tannies is hier. Prioriteite.
lines.en: The sea has vanished but the tannies are here. Priorities.

rulings.imageConcept: A False Bay tidal pool at dusk in rolling sea fog: the pool's white concrete rim curving centre-right into mist, water pewter-smooth, the ocean beyond simply gone. Four winter swimmers of different ages and races — beanies, towels around shoulders, one still waist-deep — laugh together on the steps, skin steaming faintly in the cold air. Warm dusk light diffused through the fog to soft rose-grey. No signage on walls. Portrait 9:16, top third open fog, joyful defiance of the gloom.

lines.af: Jy sien nie die huis nie. Jy gló die huis.
lines.en: You can't see the house. You believe the house.

lines.af: Die berge het vanaand vroeg gaan slaap.
lines.en: The mountains went to bed early tonight.

lines.af: Laaste een by die hek maak toe. Al sien niemand dit nie.
lines.en: Last one through closes the gate. Even if nobody can see it.

rulings.imageConcept: Drakensberg foothills at dusk: a stone-and-thatch Berg farmhouse glowing gold at the end of a fenced track, fog lying in the valley so only the roofline and lit windows float above the white. A wooden farm gate stands open in the foreground right, its chain hanging. Last blue light above the fog layer, one bright planet showing. No people, no signage. Portrait 9:16, top third open deep-blue dusk sky, farmhouse glow centre-right, the feeling of almost-home.

lines.af: Die Koppe is toe. Die aand is oop.
lines.en: The Heads are closed. The evening is open.

lines.af: Iewers blaf 'n hond en almal maak of hulle weet waar.
lines.en: Somewhere a dog is barking and everyone's pretending they know where.

lines.af: Die mis het die aand vroeg kom toedraai. Soos 'n present.
lines.en: The fog came early to gift-wrap the evening.

rulings.imageConcept: Knysna lagoon jetty at dusk in soft fog: weathered timber boards leading centre-right toward moored sailboats reduced to pale hull-shapes and single mast lights, the famous Heads completely erased. Water like brushed steel, an oystercatcher stalking the shallows lower right. Warm restaurant glow bleeds gently into the mist from off-frame right — no readable signage anywhere. Portrait 9:16, top third open silver-grey fog, tranquil, faintly mischievous in how much it's hiding.

rulings.comment: Van hier bo lyk almal se probleme vaag. Werk vir my.

lines.af: Die stad het sy duvet opgetrek. Los hom.
lines.en: The city pulled up its duvet. Leave it alone.

lines.af: Elke liggie daar onder is iemand wat ook nie kan glo dis al winter nie.
lines.en: Every glow down there is someone else who also can't believe it's already winter.

lines.af: Van hier bo lyk almal se probleme onskerp. Werk vir my.
lines.en: From up here everyone's problems look out of focus. Works for me.

rulings.imageConcept: Cape Town City Bowl from Signal Hill at night: a duvet of fog filling the bowl so the city lights glow through it like embers under ash, Lion's Head's dark shoulder rising clean above the layer on the right. Devil's Peak a faint silhouette far right. Sky above is clear indigo with a scatter of stars. No people, no vehicles, no text. Portrait 9:16, top third open starry sky, the glowing fog-sea banked centre-right, majestic and tucked-in.

rulings.comment: Iewers kerm die mishoring en 'n duisend mense sê gelyk 'ag nee'.

lines.af: Die mishoring is Seepunt se gratis witgeraas-masjien.
lines.en: The foghorn is Sea Point's free white-noise machine.

lines.af: Iewers loei die mishoring en 'n duisend mense sê gelyk 'ag nee'.
lines.en: Somewhere the foghorn moans and a thousand people say 'ag nee' at exactly the same time.

lines.af: Sewentiende verdieping, nul uitsig, honderd persent snug.
lines.en: Seventeenth floor, zero view, one hundred percent snug.

rulings.imageConcept: A glass-and-steel Atlantic seaboard apartment balcony at night: fog pressing luminous against the railing, glowing faint amber from streetlights far below, the sea and promenade entirely invisible. A young coloured woman wrapped in a thick blanket leans on the rail centre-right, plain unbranded enamel mug steaming, headphones around her neck, expression amused-resigned. Warm minimal interior behind her. Portrait 9:16, top third open glowing fog, intimate, cosy, big-city-quiet.

lines.af: Nagmis in die wingerde: die druiwe se spa-aand.
lines.en: Night fog in the vineyards: spa night for the grapes.

lines.af: Al wat jy vanaand hoor, is een uil met sterk opinies.
lines.en: Everything you can hear tonight is one owl with strong opinions.

lines.af: Die gewel het in driehonderd jaar erger gesien. Slaap gerus.
lines.en: The gable has seen worse in three hundred years. Sleep easy.

rulings.imageConcept: A Cape Dutch wine-farm werf at night in thick fog: the great white gable floating centre-right in the mist, lit softly by two old carriage lamps, ancient oak branches fading overhead. Warm candle-gold light in the small-paned windows, a low whitewashed werf wall leading in from lower right. Fog glows gently around every light source. No people, no labels, no barrels with branding. Portrait 9:16, top third open misted darkness, three centuries of calm, not a hint of menace.

rulings.comment: a Black man and a black woman in puffer jackets

lines.af: Die hond verstaan nie waar die wêreld heen is nie. Ons ook nie, boytjie. Ons ook nie.
lines.en: The dog doesn't understand where the world went. Same, boy. Same.

lines.af: Tienuur se mis maak elke straat 'n fliekstel.
lines.en: Ten pm fog turns every street into a film set.

lines.af: Joburg doen mis so selde dat dit soos 'n spesiale uitgawe voel.
lines.en: Joburg does fog so rarely it feels like a limited edition.

rulings.imageConcept: A Killarney-style Art Deco apartment block at night, its curved cream facade and porthole windows glowing softly through Johannesburg fog, sodium streetlights throwing amber cones of mist over the pavement. Centre-right, two friends — a Black man and a white woman in puffer jackets — walk a golden retriever whose leash disappears into its own small cloud, all three haloed by lamplight. Bare plane trees overhead. No signage or plates. Portrait 9:16, top third open amber mist, film-set beautiful.

lines.af: Slaptjips proe beter as die wêreld by die hawemuur ophou.
lines.en: Slap chips taste better when the world ends at the harbour wall.

lines.af: Die see is nog daar. Jy ruik hom, hy sien jou nie.
lines.en: The sea is still out there. You can smell it, but it can't see you.

lines.af: Vier vriende, een pakkie tjips, nul sig. Perfekte aand.
lines.en: Four friends, one parcel of chips, zero visibility. Perfect evening.

rulings.imageConcept: Hout Bay fishing harbour at night in dense fog: dark boat hulls and a forest of masts fading into soft grey, each masthead light a fuzzy star. On the quay centre-right, a mixed group of four friends share a newspaper-wrapped parcel of hot chips under a plain hanging bulb, steam and laughter rising together. The harbour wall dissolves into nothing beyond them. No shop signs, no boat names readable. Portrait 9:16, top third open fog and haloed mast lights, salty and convivial.

lines.af: Die sterre het 'n aand af gevat. Selfs húlle.
lines.en: The stars took a night off. Even them.

lines.af: Karoo-nagmis: so skaars dat die dominee dit môre gaan noem.
lines.en: Karoo night fog: rare enough that it'll get mentioned in church on Sunday.

lines.af: Die naaste bure is dertig kilometer weg en vanaand kan hulle jou nog minder sien.
lines.en: The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.

rulings.imageConcept: A rare Karoo night fog: a whitewashed thatched cottage right of frame, one warm lamplit window and a paraffin-style lantern glowing on the stoep, mist swallowing the veld beyond the low stone wall. Where the famous star-field should blaze, only soft charcoal fog. A plain kettle silhouette on the stoep table. No people, no text. Portrait 9:16, top third open dark mist faintly silvered by the hidden moon, deeply peaceful, the loneliness reading as luxury not gloom.

rulings.comment: Die bos vertel vanaand sy stories met n fluister.

lines.af: Diep in die bos, diep onder 'n kombers — dieselfde energie.
lines.en: Deep in the forest, deep under a blanket — exact same energy.

lines.af: Geen stroomdiens het 'n genre vir hierdie nie.
lines.en: No streaming service has a genre for this.

lines.af: Die bos vertel vanaand sy stories op fluistertoon.
lines.en: Tonight the forest is telling its stories in a whisper.

rulings.imageConcept: A timber forest cabin among Garden Route yellowwoods at night: fog threading softly between huge mossy trunks, the cabin set centre-right with deep-orange window light and a thin ribbon of woodsmoke merging into the mist. Ferns catch the glow in the foreground. Everything beyond ten metres fades to velvet grey — hushed and enclosing, never eerie. No people, no signage, no vehicles. Portrait 9:16, top third open soft dark mist in the canopy, the ultimate stay-inside advertisement.
